items.title: SpaceX發布最強語音AI模型Grok Voice 3.0 搞定七成星鏈客服來電
items.title_en: SpaceX Unveils Its Most Advanced Voice AI Model Grok Voice 3.0, Handling About 70% of Starlink Support Calls
paras: 語音AI競爭從對話能力延伸至客服任務執行。SpaceX 週三 (14日) 推出Grok Voice 3.0，稱新模型已能在無須人工介入的情況下，解決約70%的星鏈(Starlink)客服來電，宣稱是「全球最聰明的語音到語音模型。」
獨立評測平台Artificial Analysis的測試則顯示，該模型以86.9分登上語音到語音綜合指數榜首，但在使用者偏好、部分任務測試及首次回應速度上，並未全面領先。
相較於單純回答問題，Grok Voice的應用已涵蓋實際客服操作。
SpaceX表示，系統每天處理約2萬通星鏈客戶來電，可驗證客戶身分、排查硬體故障、提供帳戶折抵額度，並安排寄送替換設備。經由該系統處理的銷售來電中，每4通就有1通在通話結束前完成購買。
不過，約70%的自主解決率仍屬公司公布的內部應用數據。SpaceX未詳細揭露統計期間、問題類型分布及「自主解決」的判定標準，不能直接據此推算企業可節省的成本。
Grok Voice 3.0綜合成績居冠
Artificial Analysis的語音到語音綜合指數，涵蓋語音推理、代理執行能力、使用者偏好及任務成功率。Grok Voice 3.0得分86.9，較前代的81.3增加5.6分，高於GPT-Live-1的Astra中等推理配置版83.2分，以及Gemini 3.8 Live Extended Thinking高推理配置版82.6分。
在Speech Agent Arena測試中，Grok Voice 3.0以94.8%的任務成功率排名第一，略高於前代的94.6%；Big Bench Audio音訊推理測試得分則達98.5%，高於前代的97.2%。
但其他項目仍有競爭對手領先。Grok Voice 3.0在Tau Voice語音代理執行能力測試中得分71.6%，排名第二，低於GPT-Live-1的Astra中等配置版74.5%。使用者偏好方面，其Elo評分為1070，排名第三，落後Gemini 3.1 Flash Live Minimal的1100及Gemini 3.8 Live的1088。
這些結果顯示，新模型的綜合能力有所提升，但綜合排名居冠，並不代表每項能力或所有實際應用情境都優於競品。
官方稱延遲降低40% 第三方測得首次回應較前代慢
回應速度同樣需要區分指標。SpaceX宣稱，Grok Voice 3.0可在不到1秒內回應，並將延遲降低40%；Artificial Analysis在Big Bench Audio測試中，測得平均首次語音回應時間為0.81秒。
這個速度快於GPT-Live-1的Sol低配置版1.24秒及Astra中等配置版1.34秒，但比Grok Voice 2.0的0.70秒增加0.11秒。
官方所稱的延遲降幅，與第三方測得的首次語音回應時間並不完全對應，可能涉及不同測試場景或計算口徑，不宜直接比較。對企業而言，除了開始回應的速度，模型能否持續理解對話、正確呼叫工具並完成任務，也是部署時的重要考量。
每分鐘0.08美元 維持前代價格
Grok Voice 3.0已透過Voice Agent API及Voice Agent Builder開放使用，定價維持每分鐘0.08美元，相當於每小時4.80美元。既有開發者若使用grok-voice-latest模型別名，將自動切換至3.0，無須修改模型名稱或重新適配整套API介面。
不過，新模型並非所有競品中最便宜的選擇。依Artificial Analysis估算的每小時輸入音訊成本，GPT-Live-1的Sol低配置版為4.47美元，Gemini 3.8 Live Extended Thinking高配置版為3.50美元，均低於Grok Voice 3.0的4.80美元。
因此，這次升級的主要訴求，是在維持前代價格的同時，提高綜合能力與任務完成表現。
同步支援特斯拉車內對話
除了星鏈客服，Grok Voice 3.0也已支援特斯拉(TSLA-US)車內每天數百萬次對話。
依xAI介紹，駕駛可透過Connectors處理行事曆、訊息等日常任務，或透過Grok Bot提出訂咖啡、預約用餐等請求；系統也已整合空調、介面及車輛設定調整。
馬斯克先前曾確認，計畫讓駕駛透過語音啟用全自動輔助駕駛(FSD)相關行為，但這項整合尚未廣泛推出。
從星鏈客服到車內助理，Grok Voice 3.0的部署反映語音AI競爭正轉向實際任務執行。評測成績提供能力比較，企業最終仍須檢視模型在真實業務中的穩定性、複雜問題處理能力及整體成本。
paras_en: Voice AI competition is expanding from conversational ability to executing customer‑service tasks. On Wednesday (the 14th), SpaceX launched Grok Voice 3.0, claiming the new model can resolve roughly 70% of Starlink support calls without human intervention and calling it “the world’s smartest voice‑to‑voice model.”

An independent benchmark platform, Artificial Analysis, reported that the model topped the voice‑to‑voice composite index with a score of 86.9, but it did not lead across user‑preference metrics, some task tests, or first‑response latency.
Compared with merely answering questions, Grok Voice’s use cases now include actual support operations.

SpaceX says the system handles about 20,000 Starlink customer calls per day, can verify caller identity, troubleshoot hardware failures, offer account credit, and arrange shipment of replacement equipment. Of the sales calls processed by the system, one in four is completed with a purchase before the call ends.

However, the roughly 70% autonomous resolution rate comes from internal data disclosed by the company. SpaceX did not detail the measurement period, the distribution of issue types, or the criteria for “autonomous resolution,” so the cost savings for enterprises cannot be directly inferred.
Grok Voice 3.0 Takes the Top Spot in Composite Scores

Artificial Analysis’s voice‑to‑voice composite index covers speech reasoning, agent execution ability, user preference and task success rate. Grok Voice 3.0 scored 86.9, up 5.6 points from the previous version’s 81.3, surpassing GPT‑Live‑1 Astra medium‑reasoning configuration (83.2) and Gemini 3.8 Live Extended Thinking high‑reasoning configuration (82.6).

In the Speech Agent Arena test, Grok Voice 3.0 achieved a 94.8% task‑success rate, ranking first and slightly ahead of the prior version’s 94.6%; in the Big Bench Audio speech‑reasoning test it scored 98.5%, also higher than the previous 97.2%.

Other categories still have competitors ahead. In the Tau Voice agent‑execution test Grok Voice 3.0 scored 71.6%, placing second behind GPT‑Live‑1 Astra medium configuration (74.5%). For user preference, its Elo rating was 1070, third behind Gemini 3.1 Flash Live Minimal (1100) and Gemini 3.8 Live (1088).
These results show the new model’s overall capability has improved, but being top of the composite ranking does not mean it outperforms rivals in every individual ability or real‑world scenario.
Official Claim of 40% Latency Reduction; Third‑Party Test Shows Slightly Slower First Response

Response speed must be broken down by metric. SpaceX claims Grok Voice 3.0 can reply in under one second and has cut latency by 40%; Artificial Analysis measured an average first‑speech response time of 0.81 seconds in the Big Bench Audio test.
That is faster than GPT‑Live‑1 Sol low‑config (1.24 s) and Astra medium‑config (1.34 s), but slower than Grok Voice 2.0’s 0.70 s by 0.11 s.

The latency reduction cited by SpaceX does not map directly onto the third‑party first‑response measurement, likely due to different test scenarios or calculation methods, so direct comparison is inappropriate. For enterprises, beyond initial reply speed, the model’s ability to maintain context, correctly invoke tools and complete tasks matters most for deployment.
$0.08 per Minute, Same Price as the Previous Generation

Grok Voice 3.0 is available through the Voice Agent API and Voice Agent Builder at a price of $0.08 per minute (equivalent to $4.80 per hour). Existing developers using the grok‑voice‑latest model alias will be switched automatically to 3.0 without changing the model name or re‑adapting the API.

However, the new model is not the cheapest option among competitors. According to Artificial Analysis’s estimated hourly input‑audio cost, GPT‑Live‑1 Sol low‑config costs $4.47 per hour and Gemini 3.8 Live Extended Thinking high‑config costs $3.50 per hour, both lower than Grok Voice 3.0’s $4.80.
Thus, the main pitch of this upgrade is to boost overall capability and task performance while keeping the same price as the prior version.
Support for In‑Car Conversations in Tesla Vehicles
Beyond Starlink support, Grok Voice 3.0 also powers hundreds of thousands of daily in‑car conversations for Tesla (TSLA‑US).

According to xAI, drivers can use Connectors to manage calendars, messages and other routine tasks, or ask Grok Bot to order coffee, book a restaurant, etc.; the system is also integrated with climate control, interface and vehicle‑setting adjustments.
Musk previously confirmed plans to let drivers activate full‑self‑driving (FSD) functions via voice, but that integration has not yet been rolled out widely.

From Starlink support to in‑car assistants, the deployment of Grok Voice 3.0 shows that voice AI competition is shifting toward concrete task execution. Benchmark scores provide capability comparisons, but enterprises still need to evaluate model stability, handling of complex issues and overall cost in real‑world operations.

paras_en: U.S. inflation is heating up again, putting the Federal Reserve’s possible October rate hike back in the spotlight. September’s U.S. Consumer Price Index (CPI) rose 0.6% month‑over‑month, the biggest increase in five months, and the annual rate climbed to 3.7%. Core inflation also came in above expectations, showing price pressure is not limited to energy. After the data release, U.S. Treasury yields rose and U.S. equity futures fell, pushing the market’s probability of an October hike from about 22% to roughly 50%.

State‑owned four banks and two insurers reported their September earnings, posting a combined profit of NT$134.513 billion for the first three quarters, up 22.21% year‑over‑year and setting a new historical high for the period. Benefiting from lively Taiwan‑stock trading and solid core business growth, the state‑owned financial institutions have shown strong operating momentum this year. Mega Financial (2886‑TW) led the pack in both net profit and earnings per share, while Hua Nan Financial (2880‑TW) posted the highest growth rate, up more than 32% year‑over‑year.

CTBC Financial Holding (2891‑TW) announced on the 14th its September‑ending earnings for 2026: a monthly net profit after tax of NT$9.358 billion and a cumulative nine‑month net profit after tax of NT$63.237 billion, translating to earnings per share (EPS) of NT$3.18. Including gains from FVOCI equity instruments, the September net profit rose to NT$26.995 billion, and the nine‑month total reached NT$131.462 billion, surpassing any full‑year profit in recent history. Combined, these items added NT$6.68 per share to retained earnings.

TSMC’s earnings conference is held today. On the 14th, the Taiwan index fell sharply by 156.78 points under selling pressure in the final session, closing at 48,625.83 points, up 284.52 points overall. Trading volume reached NT$928.624 billion. The three major institutional investors sold a net NT$153.97 billion, with foreign investors alone net‑selling NT$200.37 billion for the sixth consecutive session, chiefly offloading 23,000 lots of Nanya Technology and reversing 22,000 lots of Jing Yuan Electronics.

During a rally in Alaska on the 13th local time, U.S. President Donald Trump publicly announced that Taiwan has agreed to purchase 30% of the output from the Alaska LNG project over the next 20 years and pledged an additional US$4.4 billion (about NT$1.39 trillion) to fund large‑scale energy projects, drawing intense international attention. In response, the Ministry of Economic Affairs on the 14th confirmed that to ensure stable domestic gas supply, Taiwan has consistently pursued a diversified gas sourcing strategy. Since Taiwan CPC signed a Letter of Intent for Alaska LNG in March last year, intensive negotiations and careful assessments over the past 18 months have led to significant progress with the U.S. developer.

items.title: SpaceX突限制星鏈！烏軍無人機慘遭斷網 多項任務失敗
items.title_en: SpaceX Imposes Limits on Starlink! Ukrainian Drones Suffer Connectivity Loss, Multiple Missions Fail
paras: 烏克蘭官員與軍方週三 (14 日) 指控，馬斯克旗下 SpaceX 未事先通知便對部分星鏈 (Starlink) 服務設限，導致無人機連線中斷、操控困難，多項軍事任務失敗，部分原定行動也被迫取消。烏方已要求美國政府及 SpaceX 說明，但截至報導時尚未收到回覆。
《NBC News》報導，烏克蘭總統澤倫斯基的國防科技顧問Serhii Beskrestnov 表示，SpaceX 前一夜對星鏈終端設備新增速度限制，軍用版本在移動速度超過每小時 100 英里、約 160 公里時受到限制。由於國防部隊事前未獲通知，多項任務因此失敗。
烏克蘭空中突擊部隊第 7 快速反應軍表示，前一夜開始發現星鏈連線因資料傳輸速度限制而出現問題，直接影響依賴這項服務進行飛行操控的無人機。無人機雖仍能飛行，但連線中斷使操控更加困難。
另一支在東南部札波羅熱地區作戰的部隊則表示，已被迫取消部分原定行動。一名烏克蘭官員透露，部分部隊回報，無人機即使以較低速度飛行，性能仍受到影響。
星鏈是烏軍戰場通訊與無人機運作的重要工具。馬斯克在俄羅斯於 2022 年全面入侵後不久，便在烏克蘭啟用這項服務。由於能抵抗訊號干擾，星鏈不僅支援戰場通訊，也讓烏軍得以運用更長程的無人機。
Beskrestnov指出，星鏈同時涉及防空任務，烏方利用這項服務攔截俄羅斯近幾個月用於攻擊烏克蘭城市的噴射動力無人機。烏克蘭駐美代辦謝尼克 (Denys Sienik) 表示，相關技術有助於保護平民生命，減少俄軍攻擊造成的破壞。
一名烏克蘭官員表示，軍方是在發現運作異常並提出申訴後，才從客服得知相關限制，SpaceX 並未事先告知。白宮、SpaceX 及星鏈也未立即回應。
限制措施的原因仍待釐清。Beskrestnov認為，此舉並非巧合，而是與當前政治局勢有關；部分烏方官員也因馬斯克與川普關係密切，質疑措施推出的時機。不過，報導尚未確認服務中斷與政治因素之間的關聯。
這項爭議發生之際，美烏關係正因俄羅斯能源議題持續緊張。川普希望在期中選舉前壓低汽油價格，並與俄羅斯達成柴油交易，改變美國多年來的制裁安排。他隨後要求烏克蘭停止攻擊俄國煉油廠，並呼籲撤換澤倫斯基。
基輔及其支持者擔憂，華府可能中斷戰場支援，迫使烏方在談判桌上讓步。馬斯克今年曾同意停用俄軍在烏克蘭使用的數千個星鏈終端設備，造成俄軍運作困難，但近幾日也呼應川普對烏克蘭的批評。
除星鏈通訊受阻外，烏方也正釐清盟友情資預警的狀況。澤倫斯基表示，基輔週一 (12 日) 與週二 (13 日) 接連遭俄軍彈道飛彈攻擊，兩次均未獲盟友提前警告。他強調，俄軍彈道飛彈發射情報攸關救命，但未點名美國。
針對週一的攻擊，兩名烏克蘭官員告訴《NBC News》，5 枚彈道飛彈在未獲美方提前通知的情況下擊中民用基礎設施，原因是美國情資共享發生技術問題。烏克蘭外長Andrii Sybiha 則表示，美方仍持續分享情報，並將預警延遲歸因於俄軍使用的「特殊類型武器」。
週二再次未獲預警後，官員對原因的說法出現分歧。一名烏方官員認為，連續兩次未獲通知看來並非巧合；另一名官員則歸因於天候不佳。兩名歐洲官員表示，仍在釐清原因。
川普否認扣留攸關烏克蘭防衛的情資，週二向記者表示：「我們正在幫助他們，也正在分享情報。」
烏克蘭空軍發言人Yurii Ihnat 週三也指出，第二次未獲預警的攻擊之後，接下來 3 波攻擊均收到盟友有關彈道武器使用的通知。
paras_en: Ukrainian officials and the military on Wednesday (the 14th) accused Elon Musk's SpaceX of imposing limits on parts of the Starlink service without prior notice, causing drone connections to drop, making control difficult, and leading to the failure of several military missions, with some planned operations forced to be cancelled. Kyiv has asked the U.S. government and SpaceX for an explanation, but had not received a reply at the time of reporting.

NBC News reported that Serhii Beskrestnov, the defence‑technology adviser to President Zelensky, said SpaceX added a speed restriction to Starlink terminals the night before, limiting the military version when moving faster than 100 mph (about 160 km/h). Because the defence forces were not warned in advance, multiple missions failed as a result.

Ukraine’s 7th Rapid Reaction Air Assault Brigade said that the previous night they began noticing problems with Starlink connections due to the data‑transfer speed cap, which directly affected drones that rely on the service for flight control. The drones could still fly, but the loss of connectivity made operating them much harder.

Another unit operating in the southeastern Zaporizhzhia region said it was forced to cancel some planned actions. A Ukrainian official disclosed that some units reported that even when drones flew at lower speeds, performance was still degraded.

Starlink is a critical tool for Ukrainian battlefield communications and drone operations. Musk launched the service in Ukraine shortly after Russia’s full‑scale invasion in 2022. Because it resists signal jamming, Starlink not only supports battlefield communications but also enables the Ukrainian forces to use longer‑range drones.

Beskrestnov noted that Starlink is also used for air‑defence missions, with Ukraine employing the service to intercept Russian jet‑powered drones that have been attacking Ukrainian cities in recent months. Ukrainian envoy to the U.S. Denys Sienik said the technology helps protect civilian lives and reduces damage from Russian attacks.

A Ukrainian official said the military only learned of the restriction from customer support after reporting the anomaly and filing a complaint; SpaceX had not warned them beforehand. The White House, SpaceX and Starlink did not respond immediately.

The reason for the restriction remains unclear. Beskrestnov believes the move is not a coincidence but is tied to the current political climate; some Ukrainian officials, noting Musk’s close ties to former President Trump, question the timing of the measure. However, the report has not confirmed any link between the service outage and political factors.

The dispute comes as U.S.–Ukraine relations are strained over ongoing Russian energy issues. Trump wants to lower gasoline prices before the mid‑term elections and is seeking a diesel deal with Russia, altering years of sanctions. He later urged Ukraine to stop striking Russian refineries and called for Zelensky’s removal.

Kyiv and its supporters fear Washington might cut battlefield support, forcing Ukraine to concede at the negotiating table. Musk earlier this year agreed to deactivate thousands of Starlink terminals used by Russian forces in Ukraine, hampering Russian operations, but in recent days he has echoed Trump’s criticism of Ukraine.

Beyond the Starlink communications disruption, Ukraine is also clarifying the status of allied early‑warning intelligence. Zelensky said Kyiv was hit by Russian ballistic missiles on Monday (the 12th) and Tuesday (the 13th) with no advance warning from allies on either occasion. He stressed that missile launch intelligence is life‑saving, without naming the United States.

Regarding Monday’s attack, two Ukrainian officials told NBC News that five ballistic missiles struck civilian infrastructure without prior U.S. notice because of a technical problem in U.S. intelligence sharing. Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha said the United States continues to share intelligence and blamed the warning delay on a “special type of weapon” used by Russia.

After Tuesday’s lack of warning, officials offered differing explanations. One Ukrainian official said the back‑to‑back failures to receive notice did not appear coincidental; another blamed poor weather. Two European officials said investigations into the cause are ongoing.
Trump denied withholding intelligence relevant to Ukraine’s defence, telling reporters on Tuesday, “We are helping them and we are sharing intelligence.”
Ukrainian Air Force spokesman Yurii Ihnat said on Wednesday that after the second un‑warned attack, the next three strikes did include notifications from allies about the use of ballistic weapons.

items.title: AI財富效應改寫美國家庭資產配置！股票比重超越房市 股市回檔恐衝擊更大
items.title_en: AI Wealth Effect Reshapes U.S. Household Asset Allocation! Stock Share Surpasses Real Estate, Market Pullback Could Hit Harder
paras: 美國股市多頭行情邁入第四年，人工智慧(AI)熱潮推動標普500指數連續多年大幅上漲，也改變美國家庭財富的配置結構。如今，股票在美國家庭總資產中的占比已超過30%，高於房地產約25%的比重。股市與房市走勢日益分歧，不僅反映AI熱潮帶來的財富效應，也凸顯高利率與房價負擔沉重對一般家庭造成的壓力。
《MarketWatch》報導，過去，在美國擁有房屋一向被視為累積世代財富的明確途徑，但隨著住房負擔能力危機持續，房貸利率在9月升破7%，標普500指數連年繳出雙位數漲幅，這條累積財富的傳統道路已不再那麼理所當然。
如今股票不僅超越房地產，成為美國家庭最有價值的資產類別，兩者之間的差距也持續擴大。
穆迪分析(Moody’s Analytics)首席經濟學家Mark Zandi表示：「這是AI對上房市。兩者就像經濟的兩端，AI正在引領前進，但房市卻難以跟上。」

AI推升股市財富 房市卻遭高利率壓制

根據道明證券(TD Securities)引用的數據，目前股票占美國家庭總資產的比重已超過30%，房地產則接近25%。
這種情況在過去並不常見。2000年代中期，房地產占家庭總財富的比重曾超過30%，股票則約為15%。
2008年金融危機後，新屋供給不足，使許多首購族面臨沉重的購屋能力挑戰。接著，2020年新冠疫情爆發，房價飆升，房貸利率一度低至2.65%，美國也經歷近40年來最嚴重的通膨之一。
然而，美國聯準會(Fed)自2022年起升息抗通膨，科技股卻在OpenAI於同年11月推出ChatGPT後開始強勢上漲。美國經濟的房貸利率與借貸成本不斷攀升，但投資人「害怕錯過行情」(FOMO)的情緒，也在少數強勢股票中迅速升溫，尤其是半導體股與大型科技股。
Zandi將AI產業與房市形容為「彼此的鏡像」。他指出，高利率使屋主不願出售既有房屋，並壓抑購屋需求，另一方面，少數大型科技公司大量借款，以支應AI基礎建設投資，迄今至少在一定程度上仍不受高利率影響。
Zandi表示，受益者主要是富裕階層，以及資產大多配置在股票的人。中產階級可能因退休帳戶持有股票而受惠，但借貸成本上升正帶來壓力，而他們的房屋往往是最重要的資產，短期內卻難以大幅增值。
美國10年期公債殖利率9月升破5%後，華爾街部分人士認為，殖利率可能進一步升至6%。10年期公債殖利率是新承作30年期房貸及其他家庭、企業債務的重要定價基準，若進一步攀升，將加重借款人的負擔。
不過，Zandi提醒，沒有任何一種資產類別能永遠領先，因此投資組合仍應維持多元配置。

股市愈來愈像整體經濟 財富集中恐放大市場下跌衝擊

海軍聯邦信用合作社(Navy Federal Credit Union)首席經濟學家Heather Long形容：「股市正愈來愈代表整體經濟。」這也是為什麼股市若出現大幅回檔或進入空頭市場，將對整體經濟造成重大衝擊。以2001年網路泡沫破裂後出現的經濟衰退為例，股市下跌的確可能波及更廣泛的經濟活動。
Long表示，與股市連動的財富持續增加，部分原因在於億萬富豪的財富不斷累積，以及嬰兒潮世代逐漸老去、持有資產持續累積。
這種趨勢也反映在近期較高價住宅的需求上：100萬美元級距的房屋仍吸引買家，但其他房市領域的表現已開始動搖。根據TD Cowen 10月6日發布的房市報告，房價漲幅超越收入成長，也讓民眾更難符合房貸資格。
在這樣的環境下，一些年輕人開始在金融市場追逐高風險、高報酬的投資機會，還有一些人則採取「把握當下」的生活方式，將收入用於旅行與體驗，而非儲蓄。
不過，Long也觀察到另一種趨勢：部分年輕人能在25歲左右就買下房屋。
她以海軍聯邦信用合作社的數據指出，這類購屋者多半是藍領工作者，從事軍職或技術工種，擁有穩定的收入與職涯，且通常居住在生活成本較低的地區。他們也經常利用低頭期款、甚至免頭期款的購屋方案。
Long說：「這種情況仍然少見，在我們的客戶投資組合中占比不到10%，但這反映出有些人在很年輕時就已具備一定程度的財務穩定性。」
paras_en: The U.S. stock market’s bull run has entered its fourth year, with the AI boom driving the S&P 500 to post multi‑year double‑digit gains and reshaping how American families allocate wealth. Today, stocks account for over 30% of total household assets, outpacing real estate’s roughly 25% share. The growing divergence between equities and housing reflects both the wealth‑creating power of AI and the pressure that high rates and costly homes place on typical families.

MarketWatch notes that home ownership has long been seen as a clear path to intergenerational wealth in the United States, but as the housing‑affordability crisis deepens—mortgage rates broke 7% in September—and the S&P 500 continues to deliver double‑digit annual gains, that traditional route is no longer a given.
Now stocks not only eclipse real estate but have become the most valuable asset class for U.S. households, and the gap between the two is widening.
Moody’s Analytics chief economist Mark Zandi said, “This is AI versus the housing market. They sit at opposite ends of the economy—AI is moving forward, while housing can’t keep up.”

AI lifts equity wealth while high rates suppress the housing market. According to data cited by TD Securities, stocks now make up more than 30% of U.S. household total assets, with real estate close to 25%.
Such a split was rare in the past. In the mid‑2000s, real estate accounted for over 30% of household wealth, while stocks were about 15%.

After the 2008 financial crisis, a shortage of new homes left many first‑time buyers facing steep affordability challenges. Then the COVID‑19 pandemic in 2020 sent home prices soaring and mortgage rates fell to as low as 2.65%, while the U.S. experienced one of its worst inflation spells in four decades.

However, the Fed began raising rates in 2022 to combat inflation, and tech stocks surged after OpenAI launched ChatGPT in November of that year. Even as mortgage rates and borrowing costs climb, investor fear of missing out (FOMO) has heated up in a handful of strong stocks, especially semiconductors and large‑cap tech firms.

Zandi describes the AI sector and the housing market as “mirrors of each other.” He points out that high rates discourage homeowners from selling and dampen demand, while a few big tech companies are borrowing heavily to fund AI infrastructure and, to some extent, remain insulated from rate hikes.

Zandi says the primary beneficiaries are the wealthy and those whose portfolios are heavily weighted in equities. The middle class may gain from stock holdings in retirement accounts, but rising borrowing costs create pressure, and their homes—often their biggest asset—are unlikely to see rapid appreciation in the short term.

After the 10‑year Treasury yield broke 5% in September, some Wall Street voices warned it could climb to 6%. The 10‑year yield is a key pricing benchmark for new 30‑year mortgages and other household and corporate debt, and further rises would increase borrowers’ burdens.
Nonetheless, Zandi cautions that no single asset class can stay ahead forever, so portfolios should remain diversified.

The stock market is becoming increasingly representative of the overall economy, and wealth concentration could amplify the impact of a market downturn. Navy Federal Credit Union chief economist Heather Long says, “The stock market is increasingly reflecting the whole economy,” which is why a sharp pullback or bear market could have major macroeconomic repercussions, as seen after the 2001 dot‑com bust.

Long notes that wealth tied to the market keeps growing, driven in part by the continued accumulation of billionaire fortunes and the aging of the baby‑boom generation, whose asset holdings keep expanding.

The trend also shows up in demand for higher‑priced homes: $1 million‑plus houses still attract buyers, but other segments of the market are beginning to wobble. A housing report from TD Cowen released on October 6 found that price gains outpaced income growth, making mortgage qualification harder for many.

In this environment, some younger people are chasing high‑risk, high‑reward opportunities in the financial markets, while others adopt a “live for the moment” mindset, spending income on travel and experiences rather than saving.
Long also observes another pattern: some young adults are able to purchase a home around age 25.

She cites Navy Federal data showing these buyers are mostly blue‑collar workers—military or skilled‑trade employees—with stable incomes and careers, often living in lower‑cost areas, and they frequently use low‑down‑payment or even zero‑down‑payment loan programs.
Long says, “This situation is still rare—less than 10% of our clients’ portfolios—but it shows that some people achieve a degree of financial stability at a very young age.”

items.title: 通膨還高也不急！鮑曼：Fed才升息 可以再看看
items.title_en: Inflation Still High but No Rush: Bowman Says Fed Can Wait Before Raising Rates Again
paras: 聯準會(Fed)負責金融監理的副主席鮑曼(Michelle Bowman)周三(14日)表示，雖然通膨仍高於目標，但央行9月才剛升息，目前沒有迫切需要進一步行動，可先觀察金融情勢與經濟如何演變，再決定下一步。
綜合外媒報導，鮑曼在曼谷出席國際金融協會(IIF)年度會員峰會期間指出：「我目前不覺得有採取進一步行動的急迫性，我們確實需要一些時間，了解情勢將如何發展。」
Fed上月升息1碼，將政策利率區間調高至3.75%至4.00%。鮑曼的觀望立場與近期部分官員一致，副主席傑佛森先前表示，決定是否再次升息前可能需要更多時間；紐約聯準銀行總裁威廉斯也認為無須急於行動，但今年可能仍適合再升息一次。波士頓聯準銀行總裁柯林斯則於周二表示，年底前有必要再次升息，以壓低通膨。
除了利率政策，鮑曼也談及2008年金融危機後的監管問題。她認為，部分資本要求與規範限制成長，並使大量金融活動流出受監管體系，希望透過調整，讓部分業務回流。
針對AI，鮑曼指出，前沿模型可能對關鍵基礎設施構成資安風險；資料中心建設競相籌資，也需要關注銀行及其他來源如何提供資金，確保有足夠資本支撐未來經濟。
她強調，監管仍應讓銀行參與創新。Fed正思考如何將AI納入監理工作，包括了解銀行的使用方式，以及運用AI偵測詐欺的可能性。
鮑曼也表示，在她委託檢討2023年矽谷銀行倒閉事件後，Fed需要「全面重整」監理架構，以改善監管成效並強化內部問責。
paras_en: Federal Reserve Vice Chair for Supervision Michelle Bowman said on Wednesday (the 14th) that although inflation remains above target, the central bank only just raised rates in September and there is no urgent need for further action now; the Fed can first watch how financial conditions and the economy evolve before deciding the next step.

Bowman told reporters at the International Investment Forum’s annual members’ summit in Bangkok that she does not currently feel a sense of urgency to take further action and that the Fed needs some time to see how the situation develops.

The Fed lifted rates by one quarter point last month, moving the policy rate range to 3.75%‑4.00%. Bowman’s wait‑and‑see stance aligns with several recent officials: Vice Chair Jeffers previously said more time may be needed before deciding on another hike; New York Fed President Williams also sees no need to act quickly, though another hike could be appropriate later this year; Boston Fed President Collins said a further hike before year‑end is necessary to bring inflation down.

Beyond rate policy, Bowman discussed post‑2008 financial‑crisis regulatory issues, noting that some capital requirements and rules have constrained growth and pushed a lot of financial activity out of the regulated system, and she hopes adjustments will bring some business back under supervision.

Regarding AI, Bowman warned that cutting‑edge models could pose cybersecurity risks to critical infrastructure; the rush to fund data‑center construction also raises questions about how banks and other sources provide financing, ensuring enough capital to support the future economy.

She stressed that regulation should still allow banks to participate in innovation. The Fed is considering how to incorporate AI into its supervisory work, including understanding how banks use it and the potential for AI‑based fraud detection.

Bowman also said that after she commissioned a review of the 2023 Silicon Valley Bank collapse, the Fed needs a “comprehensive overhaul” of its supervisory framework to improve regulatory effectiveness and strengthen internal accountability.

items.title: 荷姆茲海峽又出事！新加坡籍貨櫃船遇襲沉沒 21名船員全數平安
items.title_en: Incident in the Hormuz Strait Again! Singapore-Flagged Container Ship Attacked and Sank, All 21 Crew Safe
paras: 荷姆茲海峽商船遇襲情勢升級，一艘新加坡籍貨櫃船周三(14日)遭不明投射物擊中，起火後沉沒，所幸船上21名船員全數安全撤離。隨著伊朗近期加強攻擊商船，經海峽運出的原油再度減少，最新一周出口量已較美伊戰爭前正常水準低近四成。
新加坡海事及港務管理局表示，遇襲船隻為「GFS Pride」號，事件未造成人員受傷。該局在聲明中譴責，這類攻擊「毫無挑釁依據、無法合理化，且違反國際法」。
伊朗革命衛隊周三稍早透過塔斯尼姆通訊社宣稱，一艘貨櫃船觸及水雷後爆炸沉沒。不過，海事安全公司Marisks指出，目前沒有獨立證據可證實，GFS Pride號是因觸雷而沉沒。
Marisks在安全警報中表示，伊朗的說法符合其持續進行的心理戰模式，目的在於製造恐懼、增加不確定性，並阻嚇商船通過荷姆茲海峽。
近幾周，伊朗加強攻擊行經海峽的商船，試圖阻止經該水道出口的原油恢復運輸。根據英國海上貿易行動辦公室(UKMTO)事故通報，本月已有逾20艘船隻在荷姆茲海峽、波斯灣及阿曼灣遭到攻擊，其中多數為油輪。
聯合國旗下國際海事組織(IMO)表示，本月相關攻擊已造成2名船員失蹤、12人受傷。
在美軍引導油輪通過海峽的協助下，荷姆茲海峽原油出口量9月一度恢復至戰前水準，但隨攻擊增加，運輸量再度回落。
根據能源數據公司Kpler資料，截至10月12日的一周，經荷姆茲海峽出口的原油平均每日850萬桶，較戰前正常水準減少近40%。若計入通往阿曼灣與紅海的管線，整個區域原油出口量為每日1,400萬桶，仍較戰前低近20%。
每日運輸量也呈現明顯波動。Kpler指出，周一通過荷姆茲海峽的原油僅約300萬桶，前一個周五則約為600萬桶。
paras_en: The situation escalated in the Hormuz Strait when a Singapore-flagged container ship was hit by an unidentified projectile on Wednesday (the 14th), caught fire and sank, but fortunately all 21 crew members were safely evacuated. As Iran has recently stepped up attacks on merchant vessels, crude oil shipments through the strait have again declined, with the latest weekly export volume about 40% lower than pre‑war levels between the U.S. and Iran.

The Singapore Maritime and Port Authority said the vessel involved was the "GFS Pride" and that the incident caused no injuries. In its statement the agency condemned the attack as "without any provocation, indefensible and a violation of international law."

The Iranian Revolutionary Guard claimed early Wednesday via the Tasnim news agency that a container ship had struck a mine and exploded, sinking. However, maritime safety firm Marisks said there is currently no independent evidence confirming that the GFS Pride sank because it hit a mine.

Marisks noted in its safety alert that Iran’s claim fits its ongoing psychological‑war pattern aimed at sowing fear, increasing uncertainty and deterring merchant ships from transiting the Hormuz Strait.

In recent weeks Iran has intensified attacks on vessels passing through the strait in an effort to halt the resumption of crude exports via the waterway. According to incident reports from the UK Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO), more than 20 ships have been attacked this month in the Hormuz Strait, the Persian Gulf and the Gulf of Oman, most of them tankers.
The United Nations‑affiliated International Maritime Organization (IMO) said the attacks this month have resulted in two crew members missing and twelve injured.
With U.S. forces escorting tankers through the strait, Hormuz crude exports briefly returned to pre‑war levels in September, but increased attacks have caused volumes to fall again.

Based on data from energy analytics firm Kpler, the average daily crude export through the Hormuz Strait during the week ending 12 October was 8.5 million barrels, roughly 40% below pre‑war normal levels. Including pipelines to the Gulf of Oman and the Red Sea, the region’s total daily crude export was about 14 million barrels, still nearly 20% lower than before the war.

Daily volumes have also shown marked swings. Kpler reported that on Monday only about 3 million barrels of crude passed through the Hormuz Strait, compared with roughly 6 million barrels the previous Friday.

items.title: 柴油變貴一路傳！Fed褐皮書揭成本壓力 企業預期還會漲價
items.title_en: Diesel Prices Rise Across the Board! Fed Beige Book Reveals Cost Pressures, Companies Expect Further Price Hikes
paras: 聯準會(Fed)周三(14日)公布最新褐皮書指出，美國部分地區物價壓力加劇，柴油與能源成本透過燃料附加費向供應鏈傳導，關稅、其他原物料及保險也持續推高成本。經濟活動整體小幅成長，就業則維持「低招聘、低裁員」格局，凸顯Fed在抑制通膨與評估經濟韌性之間的政策難題。
這份報告由費城聯準銀行彙整，資料蒐集截至10月5日，反映12個轄區企業等受訪者的觀察，並不代表Fed官員立場。報告發布前，同日公布的9月CPI年增3.7%，高於預期，市場對10月27日至28日會議升息的押注升至約37%。

能源成本傳遍供應鏈 企業預期仍有漲價壓力

12個轄區中，3區形容物價漲勢強勁，8區為溫和上漲，其中3區指出投入成本壓力正在加劇，另1區漲幅較小。此外，4個轄區表示，價格上漲速度較前次調查加快。
所有轄區報告均提及油價上升的影響。企業指出，柴油價格居高不下，燃料附加費將成本向供應鏈各環節傳遞；多區也反映，其他原物料、關稅與保險費用仍構成壓力。
不過，面向消費者的企業難以全面轉嫁成本，對價格敏感的顧客持續抗拒漲價，使利潤率受到壓縮。業者因而採取選擇性調價、針對性促銷，以及調整菜單等方式降低成本、維持獲利。
多區企業預期，隨現有合約到期，必須重新議定投入成本的避險合約或對客戶的交付合約，未來數月仍可能進一步漲價。能源與關稅政策的不確定性，也讓企業更難規劃。

成長仰賴製造業與高收入族群 AI影響招聘

經濟活動方面，2個轄區呈現溫和成長、3區小幅成長、4區微幅成長，另3區無明顯變化。達拉斯製造業成長強勁且廣泛，另有6區製造業小幅至溫和擴張，但其他產業整體成長有限。
多數轄區消費支出幾乎沒有變化，逾半數指出消費主要由高收入家庭支撐。即使零售表現穩健的達拉斯，也有低收入顧客更加謹慎的回報；6個提供汽車銷售資訊的轄區中，5區銷量持平至小幅下降。
就業整體變化不大，勞動力供應大致足以滿足需求，但專業、技術及熟練技工仍短缺。5個轄區指出，部分企業投資AI提升生產力後，透過自然流失縮減人力、延後招聘，或預期未來新增就業機會減少。
薪資普遍上升，通膨也帶動員工爭取生活成本調薪，福利成本增加則加重企業負擔。企業對未來數月大致保持正面展望，但多僅預期微幅成長，動能偏重製造業，且仍受持續不確定性牽制。
paras_en: The Federal Reserve released its latest Beige Book on Wednesday (Oct. 14), noting that price pressures are intensifying in parts of the United States. Diesel and energy costs are being passed through the supply chain via fuel surcharges, while tariffs, other raw‑material costs and insurance continue to push expenses higher. Overall economic activity grew modestly, and employment remained in a “low hiring, low layoffs” pattern, highlighting the Fed’s dilemma between curbing inflation and gauging economic resilience.

The report, compiled by the Federal Reserve Bank of Philadelphia, draws on data collected through Oct. 5 from respondents in 12 districts and does not represent the views of Fed officials. It was released the same day that September’s CPI showed a 3.7% year‑over‑year increase, above expectations, raising market odds of a rate hike at the Oct. 27‑28 meeting to about 37%.

Energy costs are rippling through the supply chain, and firms still expect price‑increase pressure. Among the 12 districts, three described price gains as strong, eight saw moderate increases, three said input‑cost pressure is tightening, and one reported a smaller rise. Four districts noted that price growth has accelerated since the previous survey.

All districts mentioned the impact of higher oil prices. Companies said diesel prices remain elevated and fuel surcharges are transmitting costs to every link in the supply chain; many also reported that other raw‑material costs, tariffs and insurance premiums continue to weigh on expenses.

However, firms that sell directly to consumers find it hard to pass on all costs. Price‑sensitive customers keep resisting hikes, squeezing profit margins. As a result, businesses are using selective price adjustments, targeted promotions and menu changes to cut costs and preserve earnings.

Several districts said that as existing contracts expire, firms will have to renegotiate hedging agreements or delivery contracts with customers, meaning further price increases are possible in the coming months. Uncertainty around energy and tariff policy also makes planning more difficult.

Growth relies on manufacturing and high‑income households; AI’s impact on hiring. Regarding economic activity, two districts reported moderate growth, three modest growth, four slight growth and three no clear change. Dallas showed strong, broad‑based manufacturing growth, while six other districts saw manufacturing expand modestly to moderately; growth in other sectors was limited.

Most districts saw consumer spending virtually unchanged, with more than half saying spending is being supported mainly by high‑income families. Even in Dallas, where retail is robust, low‑income customers are becoming more cautious; among six districts that provided auto‑sales data, five reported sales flat to slightly down.

Employment changes were modest overall, with labor supply generally sufficient to meet demand, but shortages persisted for professionals, technicians and skilled trades. Five districts noted that some firms, after investing in AI to boost productivity, are reducing headcount through natural attrition, delaying hires, or expecting fewer new jobs in the future.

Wages are broadly rising, and inflation is prompting workers to seek cost‑of‑living adjustments, while higher benefit costs add to corporate burdens. Companies remain roughly optimistic for the next few months but mostly anticipate only modest growth, with momentum leaning toward manufacturing and still constrained by ongoing uncertainties.

items.title: 法盛投資管理：AI熱潮席捲亞洲 投資人期待高報酬卻面臨風險落差
items.title_en: Faseng Investment Management: AI Wave Sweeps Asia, Investors Seek High Returns but Face Risk Gaps
paras: 過去18個月來，全球 AI 浪潮帶動亞洲股市大幅上揚，投資人對未來的長期回報預期亦隨之水漲船高。然而，法盛投資管理發布《2026 年亞洲投資人脈動調查》，發現亞洲投資人的預期報酬率與其風險承受能力之間存在顯著落差。面對 Fed 政策走勢與市場波動，專家建議善用美國股市的多樣性與非投資級債等配置，落實資產分散以確保長期穩健收益。
根據法盛投資管理於2026年8月針對香港、日本、新加坡、南韓及台灣共750名可投資資產達10萬美元以上投資人的調查，亞洲投資人預期的長期實質回報率(扣除通膨後)高達17.3%。其中以新加坡(20%)與南韓(19.6%)最高，南韓投資人的回報預期甚至是理財顧問合理推估(9.3%)的兩倍以上。
然而，調查中有 73% 的受訪者自認屬於保守型或穩健型投資人，顯現出市場出現顯著的「近因偏誤」，投資人因近期股市大漲而盲目調高預期，卻忽視了潛在的市場波動與風險承受極限。
法盛投資人洞察中心執行董事 Dave Goodsell 表示，亞洲投資人受到錯失恐懼(FOMO)驅使，對收益追求極為積極。例如南韓與台灣市場深受AI供應鏈及半導體題材帶動，投資人期望極高，但同時也面臨顯著的波動度與「機會風險」。相比之下，新加坡投資人的高預期則更多來自金融銀行業對AI產業融資及放款所帶來的效益。
針對美國聯準會 (Fed) 政策展望，法盛分析指出，Fed 官員(如Christopher Waller)近期言論偏向支持維持甚至調升利率以控制通膨與市場需求，目前預測利率將維持在4.25%左右，政策主軸在於引導經濟穩健發展而非阻礙成長。
在固定收益市場方面，法盛表示，近期市場波動加劇，投資級債券利差持續收窄，吸引力有所降低。相反地，對非投資等級債抱持較為積極的態度，主因其提供的利差回報能合理補償投資人承擔的風險，且在高利息收益的緩衝下，能有效降低市場修正帶來的衝擊。
針對台韓兩地在AI供應鏈中的地位，法盛分析，台灣在半導體與先進製造領域高居全球領導地位，對美國及全球市場而言均為不可或缺的關鍵夥伴。然而，台灣市場的產業集中度較高，相較之下，美股市場雖然同樣受到科技股驅動，但其整體經濟更具多樣性，涵蓋公用事業、能源、金融服務及工業製造(如波音)等多種板塊。
法盛提醒，隨著AI資本支出與市場競爭加劇，未來幾年市場將逐步回歸常態化，唯有具備強大現金流與獲利能力的龍頭企業能夠持續生存，而弱勢企業恐面臨融資困難。因此，投資人在追逐AI高報酬的同時，應特別注意避免過度集中於單一科技製造業，利用美股等多元化市場或非投資級債券分散風險。此外，台幣與美元高度相關，投資人應將匯率波動與技術創新週期納入考量。
調查也顯示，93%的台灣投資人比以往更重視跨區域分散，台灣投資人持有被動式ETF(61%)與主動式ETF(59%)的比例居亞洲之冠，顯示出台灣投資人在運用多元工具進行靈活配置上已日益成熟。
paras_en: Over the past 18 months, the global AI wave has driven Asian stock markets sharply higher, raising investors' expectations for long‑term returns. However, Faseng Investment Management’s "2026 Asian Investor Sentiment Survey" finds a significant gap between Asian investors’ expected returns and their risk tolerance. In light of Fed policy trends and market volatility, experts advise leveraging the diversity of U.S. equities and non‑investment‑grade bonds to achieve asset diversification and ensure steady long‑term gains.

Based on a survey conducted by Faseng Investment Management in August 2026 of 750 investors in Hong Kong, Japan, Singapore, South Korea and Taiwan who each have investable assets of at least $100,000, Asian investors expect a long‑term real (inflation‑adjusted) return of 17.3%. Singapore tops the list at 20% and South Korea follows at 19.6%, with South Korean investors’ expectations more than double the reasonable estimate of 9.3% offered by financial advisers.

Yet 73% of respondents describe themselves as conservative or moderate investors, revealing a pronounced "recency bias" in the market: investors have blindly raised expectations after recent stock market rallies while overlooking potential volatility and their own risk limits.

Dave Goodsell, Executive Director of Faseng’s Investor Insights Center, says Asian investors are driven by FOMO and pursue returns aggressively. For example, South Korean and Taiwanese markets are heavily influenced by AI supply‑chain and semiconductor themes, prompting very high expectations but also exposing investors to significant volatility and "opportunity risk". By contrast, Singapore investors’ lofty expectations stem more from the benefits of AI‑related financing and lending in the financial‑banking sector.

Regarding the Federal Reserve outlook, Faseng analysts note that Fed officials such as Christopher Waller have recently signaled support for maintaining or even raising rates to curb inflation and demand, with rates expected to stay around 4.25%. The policy focus is on guiding stable economic growth rather than stifling it.

In the fixed‑income arena, Faseng observes that recent market turbulence has narrowed investment‑grade bond spreads, reducing their appeal. Conversely, they take a more positive stance on non‑investment‑grade debt, citing its spread premium as a reasonable compensation for risk and its high‑interest buffer that can mitigate the impact of market corrections.

Analyzing the AI supply‑chain roles of Taiwan and South Korea, Faseng points out that Taiwan leads globally in semiconductors and advanced manufacturing, making it an indispensable partner for the U.S. and worldwide. However, Taiwan’s market is highly concentrated, whereas the U.S. market, though also tech‑driven, is more diversified across utilities, energy, financial services, industrial manufacturing (e.g., Boeing) and other sectors.

Faseng cautions that as AI capital spending and competition intensify, markets will gradually normalize over the next few years. Only companies with strong cash flow and profitability will survive, while weaker firms may face financing difficulties. Investors chasing AI’s high returns should avoid over‑concentration in a single tech manufacturing segment and use diversified markets like U.S. equities or non‑investment‑grade bonds to spread risk. Additionally, given the high correlation between the Taiwanese dollar and the U.S. dollar, currency fluctuations and technology‑innovation cycles should be factored into decisions.

The survey also shows that 93% of Taiwanese investors now place greater emphasis on cross‑regional diversification. Taiwanese investors hold passive ETFs (61%) and active ETFs (59%) at the highest rates in Asia, indicating a growing sophistication in using diverse tools for flexible portfolio allocation.

items.title: 〈智慧能源週〉聯華林德最快2028引進氫能車 「富氧燃燒」助台廠減碳、降廢氣排放
items.title_en: Smart Energy Week: Linde Lihua to Introduce Hydrogen Vehicles by 2028, Oxygen-Enriched Combustion Helps Taiwanese Plants Cut Carbon and Emissions
paras: 工業氣體廠聯華林德今(2026)年參與台灣國際智慧能源周展，大宗氣體暨清淨能源副總沈欣儒今(14)日表示，隨著工業減碳應用實績持續擴大，富氧燃燒技術已獲多家指標業者導入，藉由降低廢氣量、提升燃燒效率，產能可增加逾 50%，燃料耗用最高可降低 50%。
沈欣儒表示，目前聯華林德為串聯物流、運輸與氫能產業，推動「氫能即服務(HaaS)」模式，加速應用產業落地，目前在氫能運輸領域克服法規與成本門檻，應用在氫能大客車上，預計在 2028 年引進首批歐洲氫能重型車輛，朝在地化組裝發展。
另隨綠色新能源、低碳運輸工具正夯，連政府也宣布在2030年希望達到全電動車行駛，目前包括新能源車持續蓬勃湧現，全球氫能運輸逐漸以重型卡車、巴士及物流車等商用車為主要發展。
沈欣儒表示，公司繼去(2025)年與中油合作，共同完成加氫站建置後，聯華林德攜手聯華新能源及亞氫動力，進一步串聯物流車隊與運輸業者，導入符合歐規的氫能卡車，目標透過整合採購與服務模式，以降低客戶初期資本支出，加速氫能運輸導入時程。
沈欣儒坦言，聯華林德深耕氫能車多年，但目前台灣因為車用及道路法規嚴格限制下，台灣現階段僅對「氫能巴士」的大客車給予專案補貼，缺乏對其他重型車輛運輸的補助辦法，這也讓業者成為未來急需努力突破產業限制。
其次是氫汽車供應鏈的限制，沈欣儒表示，目前全球最大的氫能車輛生產基地在中國，但台灣受限於法規無法進口中國車輛，也增加導入組裝或生產的難度。
沈欣儒表示，目前聯華林德已引進約5輛「氫能巴士」大客車，目標是引進10輛左右數量，正進行政府的行駛及道路交通認證中，也與歐洲的貨車與卡車大廠洽談，預計最晚 2028 年引進首批車輛進口後，在進行驗證後可行駛於台灣。
至於初期引進的氫能巴士在價格部分，目前僅能原裝整輛氫能車經海關進口台灣，沈欣儒透露一輛車價格進口約台幣3千萬元左右，未來希望經過認證後，能夠逐步採取「在地化組裝」策略，期望藉此大幅降低建置成本，並配合政府未來可能的補貼，以利於各式各樣的氫能車在台灣落地銷售。
此外，隨台灣正式邁入碳定價新階段，聯華林德此次也展出富氧燃燒技術，可協助高碳排產業改善燃燒製程、提升能源效率，為工業減碳的重要技術選項，目前包括台泥(1101-TW)、華新(1605-TW)麗華、金聯成、羅東鋼鐵等業者已陸續導入相關技術，納入整體節能減碳策略中
日本知名煉鋼大廠千代田鋼鐵導入無焰純氧解決方案 OXYGON ，實測效益顯示： 燃氣消耗減少58.2%，盛鋼桶預熱時間從 5小時40分鐘縮短至 3小時。富氧/純氧燃燒所具備的低碳燃料轉換、製程改善及效能提升等特性，亦符合企業自主減量的減碳策略方向，聯華林德可依客戶需求打造解決方案，透過降低廢氣量及提升燃燒效率，產能最高可提升50% 以上。
paras_en: Linde Lihua, a industrial gases company, participated in Taiwan International Smart Energy Week this year. Deputy General Manager of Bulk Gases and Clean Energy, Shen Xinru, said that as industrial carbon‑reduction applications continue to expand, oxygen‑enriched combustion technology has already been adopted by several leading firms. By lowering exhaust volume and improving combustion efficiency, capacity can increase by more than 50% and fuel consumption can be cut by up to 50%.

Shen explained that Linde Lihua is linking logistics, transportation and the hydrogen sector to promote a “Hydrogen‑as‑a‑Service (HaaS)” model, accelerating market rollout. In the hydrogen‑transport arena, the company has overcome regulatory and cost barriers and is applying the technology to large hydrogen buses, with plans to bring the first batch of European heavy‑duty hydrogen vehicles to Taiwan in 2028 and develop local assembly.

With green new energy and low‑carbon transport gaining momentum, the government has announced a goal of achieving an all‑electric vehicle fleet by 2030. New‑energy vehicles continue to surge worldwide, and hydrogen transport is increasingly focused on heavy trucks, buses and logistics vehicles as the main commercial‑vehicle segment.

Shen noted that after completing a joint hydrogen‑refueling station with CPC Corp. in 2025, Linde Lihua partnered with Lihua New Energy and Asia Hydrogen Power to further connect logistics fleets and carriers, introducing European‑spec hydrogen trucks. The aim is to lower customers’ upfront capital costs through integrated procurement and service models, speeding up hydrogen‑fuel transport adoption.

Shen admitted that although Linde Lihua has been cultivating hydrogen vehicles for years, Taiwan’s strict vehicle and road regulations currently only provide project subsidies for large hydrogen buses. There is no support for other heavy‑vehicle transport, creating a pressing industry hurdle that must be overcome.

A second challenge is the hydrogen‑vehicle supply chain. Shen said the world’s largest hydrogen‑vehicle production base is in China, but Taiwanese regulations prohibit importing Chinese vehicles, adding difficulty to local assembly or manufacturing efforts.

Shen said Linde Lihua has already imported about five hydrogen buses, targeting roughly ten units. The fleet is undergoing government driving and road‑traffic certification, and talks are underway with major European truck manufacturers. The first batch is expected to arrive by 2028, after which verification will allow operation in Taiwan.

Regarding price, the initial hydrogen buses can only be imported as complete units. Shen disclosed that each vehicle costs about NT$30 million to import. The company hopes that, after certification, a “local‑assembly” strategy will dramatically lower costs and, together with possible future subsidies, enable a variety of hydrogen vehicles to be sold in Taiwan.

In addition, as Taiwan moves into a new phase of carbon pricing, Linde Lihua showcased its oxygen‑enriched combustion technology, which can help high‑carbon industries improve combustion processes and boost energy efficiency—an important option for industrial decarbonisation. Companies such as Taiwan Cement (1101‑TW), Hwa‑Shin (1605‑TW), Lihua, Jin‑Lian‑Cheng and Luodong Steel have begun adopting the technology as part of broader energy‑saving and carbon‑reduction strategies.

Japanese steel giant Chiyoda Steel has adopted the flame‑free pure‑oxygen solution OXYGON, achieving a 58.2% reduction in gas consumption and cutting pre‑heat time for steel ladles from 5 hours 40 minutes to 3 hours. The low‑carbon fuel conversion, process improvement and efficiency gains of oxygen‑enriched/pure‑oxygen combustion align with corporate emission‑reduction goals, and Linde Lihua can tailor solutions to customer needs, reducing exhaust and raising capacity by more than 50%.

items.title_en: State-Owned Financial Holdings Post Strong Q3 Earnings of NT$134.5 Billion, Over 20% Growth; Mega Financial Tops Both Profit and EPS Rankings, Hua Nan Financial Near Last Year's Full-Year Level
paras: 公股四金二銀9月自結盈餘全數出爐，累計前三季合賺1345.13億元，年增22.21%，續創歷史同期新高。受惠台股交投熱絡與核心業務穩健發展，公股金融機構今年營運動能強勁，其中兆豐金 (2886-TW) 穩居獲利與每股稅後純益雙冠王，華南金 (2880-TW) 則以年增逾32%的表現拿下成長幅度之冠。
公股四金二銀9月單月合計獲利131.84億元，月減15.46%，主要受配息旺季結束及部分金融商品評價收益減少影響；但累計前三季整體獲利仍衝破1345億元大關，較去年同期顯著成長逾兩成。整體來看，除了銀行本業核心利息與手續費收入維持穩健外，證券子公司受惠台股大行情，自營及承銷收益大爆發，成為推升集團獲利改寫歷史新高的關鍵引擎。
兆豐金 (2886-TW) 9月單月稅後純益36.29億元，為公股六家唯一呈現月增。主要受惠兆豐證券自營與承銷獲利較上月增加逾5億元帶動，儘管兆豐銀行9月增加呆帳及其他各項提存，抵銷部分證券獲利增幅，金控單月獲利仍維持微幅上升。累計前三季兆豐金稅後純益達328.48億元，創歷年同期新高。
其中兆豐證券獲利年增約173%表現最為亮眼，經紀手續費與自營承銷收益同步暴增，9月單月獲利亦刷新歷史紀錄；兆豐銀行前三季稅後純益248.18億元、年增約6%，同樣刷新同期紀錄。兆豐票券前三季獲利年增約33%，主要受債券部位利差提升、外幣債券利息費用減少及票券成交量增加帶動；兆豐產險前三季獲利8.6億元，年增約29%。
華南金 (2880-TW) 前三季獲利增幅最為驚人，累計稅後純益263.67億元，年增32.43%，每股稅後純益達1.88元，前三季累計獲利已大幅逼近去年全年水準。華南金指出，除了銀行本業穩健成長外，證券及產險等非銀行子公司貢獻明顯提升，非銀行獲利占比提升至23%，成為驅動整體金控獲利暴增的第二支柱。
第一金 (2892-TW) 前三季累計獲利262.25億元，年增20.86%，每股稅後純益為1.82元。雖然9月受到配息旺季結束與金融商品評價損失影響，但第一銀行核心業務依舊強韌，第一金證券在投資與承銷收益挹注下，前三季獲利順利突破20億元大關，惟第一金人壽9月表現由盈轉虧。
合庫金 (5880-TW) 9月合併稅後淨利為19.24億元，累計前三季合併稅後淨利達202.49億元，年增26.8%，每股稅後純益1.22元，續創歷年同期新高。旗下主要獲利來源包括合庫銀行、合庫證券及合庫人壽，累計稅後淨利均創下歷史同期新高。
其中合庫銀行前三季累計稅後淨利179.84億元、年增12.07%；合庫證券累計稅後淨利17.22億元，較去年同期大增15.42億元；合庫人壽累計稅後淨利12.95億元，年增5.73億元，加上合庫票券、合庫資產管理與合庫創投等子公司同步獲利成長，整體集團展現多元獲利動能。
在兩家公股銀行方面，彰銀 (2801-TW) 累計前9月稅前盈餘已突破200億元大關，前九月累計合併稅後盈餘173.7億元，年增22.76%，主要得益於核心業務利息及手續費淨收益表現良好，展現極為穩定的獲利韌性。
臺企銀 (2834-TW) 9月獲利因遠匯與換匯交易處分、評價收益及股利收入減少影響，月減22.41%；但累計前九月獲利仍較去年同期成長約17%，主因存放利差擴大帶動利息淨收益大幅增加，營運基本面依舊健全。
paras_en: State-owned financial holdings comprising four banks and two insurers released their September consolidated earnings, showing a cumulative profit of NT$134.513 billion for the first three quarters, up 22.21% year‑over‑year and setting a new historical high for the period. Benefiting from lively Taiwan‑stock trading and solid core business development, these institutions showed strong operating momentum this year, with Mega Financial (2886‑TW) retaining the top spots for both net profit and earnings per share, while Hua Nan Financial (2880‑TW) claimed the highest growth rate with a year‑over‑year increase of more than 32%.

The four banks and two insurers posted a combined September profit of NT$13.184 billion, down 15.46% month‑over‑month, mainly due to the end of the dividend‑distribution season and reduced valuation gains on some financial products; nevertheless, the cumulative profit for the first three quarters still surpassed the NT$134.5 billion mark, representing a growth of over 20% compared with the same period last year. Overall, besides stable core interest and fee income from banking operations, securities subsidiaries rode the surge in Taiwan‑stock market activity, with proprietary trading and underwriting revenues exploding and becoming the key engine that pushed group profits to historic highs.

Mega Financial (2886‑TW) recorded a September net profit after tax of NT$3.629 billion, the only one among the six state‑owned institutions to show a month‑over‑month increase. The boost came mainly from Mega Securities, whose proprietary trading and underwriting earnings rose by more than NT$0.5 billion from the prior month, offset partially by higher loan loss provisions and other reserves at Mega Bank. Still, the financial holding’s monthly profit edged higher. For the first three quarters, Mega Financial’s net profit after tax reached NT$32.848 billion, a record high for the same period in history.

Mega Securities posted an eye‑catching year‑over‑year profit increase of about 173%, with brokerage fees and proprietary‑underwriting revenues soaring together, and its September profit also set a new record. Mega Bank posted a three‑quarter net profit after tax of NT$24.818 billion, up roughly 6% year‑over‑year, also a record for the period. Mega’s securities‑trading unit saw a three‑quarter profit rise of about 33%, driven by wider bond‑margin spreads, lower foreign‑currency bond interest expenses and higher bond‑trading volumes. Mega’s property‑and‑casualty insurance arm earned NT$860 million for the three quarters, up about 29% year‑over‑year.

Hua Nan Financial (2880‑TW) posted the most striking profit growth for the first three quarters, with cumulative net profit after tax of NT$26.367 billion, up 32.43% year‑over‑year, and earnings per share of NT$1.88. The three‑quarter profit has already closed in on last year’s full‑year level. Hua Nan noted that, beyond steady growth in its banking core, contributions from non‑bank subsidiaries such as securities and property‑insurance rose markedly, lifting the share of non‑bank profit to 23% and becoming the second pillar driving the overall surge in holding‑company earnings.

First Financial (2892‑TW) accumulated a profit of NT$26.225 billion for the first three quarters, up 20.86% year‑over‑year, with earnings per share of NT$1.82. Although September was affected by the end of the dividend season and valuation losses on financial products, First Bank’s core business remained resilient. First Financial Securities, bolstered by investment and underwriting income, pushed three‑quarter profit past the NT$2 billion threshold, while First Life turned from profit to loss in September.

Hua Nan Bank (5880‑TW) reported a September consolidated net profit after tax of NT$1.924 billion, bringing the three‑quarter consolidated net profit to NT$20.249 billion, up 26.8% year‑over‑year, with earnings per share of NT$1.22, again a record high for the period. Its main profit sources—Hua Nan Bank, Hua Nan Securities and Hua Nan Life—each posted historic‑period net profits.

For the three quarters, Hua Nan Bank posted a consolidated net profit after tax of NT$17.984 billion, up 12.07% year‑over‑year; Hua Nan Securities recorded NT$1.722 billion, a jump of NT$1.542 billion from the prior year; and Hua Nan Life earned NT$1.295 billion, up NT$0.573 billion. Together with profit growth from Hua Nan’s bond‑trading, asset‑management and venture‑capital subsidiaries, the group demonstrated diversified profit momentum.

Among the two state‑owned banks, Chang Hwa Bank (2801‑TW) saw its cumulative pre‑tax earnings for the first nine months exceed NT$20 billion, and its combined net profit after tax reached NT$17.37 billion, up 22.76% year‑over‑year, driven mainly by strong net interest and fee income from core operations, showcasing very stable profitability resilience.

Taiwan Business Bank (2834‑TW) posted a September profit decline of 22.41% month‑over‑month due to reduced gains from foreign‑exchange trading, valuation income and dividend receipts, yet its cumulative profit for the first nine months still grew about 17% versus the prior year, primarily because widening deposit‑rate spreads boosted net interest income, keeping the bank’s operational fundamentals sound.

items.title: 輝達再度出資台廠：預付京元電美國測試產能和認購聯發科ECB有何不同？
items.title_en: Nvidia Invests Again in Taiwanese Firms: How Does Its Prepayment to ASE Technology’s US Test Capacity Differ from Its Subscription to MediaTek’s ECB?
paras: 輝達 (NVDA) 繼8月底認購聯發科 (2454-TW) 海外可轉換公司債後，10月13日再與京元電 (2449-TW) 簽訂客戶預付款協議，接連以資金支持台灣半導體供應鏈。
不過，兩案雖同樣獲輝達資金挹注，合作目的及成長想像並不相同；前者是策略投資，後者則是預付測試服務費、提前鎖定產能。

對聯發科：認購可轉債合作充滿想像
聯發科8月31日宣布發行總額39億美元的海外可轉換公司債（ECB），輝達認購其中35億美元，債券票面利率為零，持有人未來得依約轉換為聯發科股票。
這筆交易使輝達取得債權及潛在股權，而非立即成為股東；對聯發科而言，則是在可轉債架構下取得長期資金，支持研發與業務擴展。
更關鍵的是，雙方同步宣布擴大AI基礎建設、終端AI運算及車用平台合作。聯發科在既有NVLink Fusion合作基礎上，進一步深化ASIC與機櫃級AI系統整合，降低CSP導入客製化XPU的門檻，不必完全從零打造Scale-up互連、記憶體架構及機櫃整合系統，這讓聯發科有機會爭取更多設計與系統整合商機。

對京元電：預付貨款確保後段產能供給
京元電則由公司及旗下美國子公司AeternZ與輝達簽署客戶預付款協議，由輝達先付款，京元電在美建置並預留測試產能，後續提供服務再逐步抵減。這筆資金並非股權投資，也不是收款當下即可認列的營收，其作用在於支撐美國廠初期投資、減輕資金壓力及提高產能需求能見度。
值得注意的是，京元電在9月17日曾因應美國子公司與客戶簽訂產能建置及保留合約需求，核准提供最高3億美元的連帶保證，顯示客戶原先要求台灣母公司為美國新廠履約提供保障。
不過京元電10月13日同步宣布取消該背書保證，改為共同輝達簽訂預付款協議的方式。
此次調整不僅確認輝達為美國測試產能的重要合作客戶，也讓雙方資金支持與產能保留的商業模式更加明確，但對於市場沒有進一步的驚喜：
京元電與輝達的合作早已深入核心測試業務。京元電8月底法說會指出，2025年上半年由GPU客戶率先帶動擴產，下半年再加入ASIC需求，且客戶集中度持續提高。2025年財報更顯示，最大單一客戶營收貢獻達126.5億元、占比36%，較前一年的18%倍增。
（圖片來源：優分析產業數據中心）
雖然公司未揭露該客戶身分，但結合輝達官方已將京元電列入Vera Rubin供應鏈，以及法人對Rubin GPU、Vera CPU測試訂單的分析，市場高度推測輝達已躍居京元電第一大客戶，更有法人預估輝達已佔京元電營收50%以上。
除了雙方合作早已在市場預期內，該預付協議條款亦未公開，因此無法確認實際風險分攤及訂單保障程度。
京元電2026全年資本支出於4月上調至500億元；而美國投資額上限為14億美元，於7月正式核准，規劃2028年小量運轉。
不過，隨AI晶片封裝與功耗提高，法人預期測試時間、預燒及散熱需求將同步提升，京元電的高功耗測試能力可望轉化為更高的單顆晶片測試價值。輝達選擇以預付款預留產能，也凸顯後段測試在供應鏈中的關鍵地位。
因此，兩案利多的時間與性質有別。聯發科最具想像的是藉輝達生態系開拓新客戶、新產品，ASIC業務成長有望擴大；
相較之下，京元電原本就是輝達重要GPU測試夥伴，美國設廠與客戶產能保留規劃也早已揭露。此次預付款協議的突破，主要在於確認輝達願意提供資金支持，降低海外建廠的資金壓力並確保己方需求無虞，但沒有進一步的數字與份額可以觀察。
京元電尚未揭露預付款金額、最低採購量及美國廠獲利條件，14億美元也只是投資額上限，不等同輝達資金承諾。能否進一步推升獲利，仍須觀察新廠稼動率、測試單價與成本結構，在後續產能爬坡時對於整體營利的影響。

paras_en: Nvidia (NVDA) followed its late‑August subscription to MediaTek (2454‑TW) overseas convertible bonds with a customer pre‑payment agreement with ASE Technology (2449‑TW) on October 13, continuing to fund Taiwan’s semiconductor supply chain with cash.

However, although both deals receive Nvidia funding, their purposes and growth narratives differ; the former is a strategic investment, while the latter is a pre‑payment for test services and an advance reservation of capacity.

For MediaTek: the convertible bond subscription is full of imagination. MediaTek announced on August 31 the issuance of $3.9 billion of overseas convertible bonds (ECB), of which Nvidia subscribed $3.5 billion. The bonds carry a zero coupon rate and holders can later convert them into MediaTek shares under the agreed terms.

This transaction gives Nvidia a debt claim and potential equity, not immediate shareholder status; for MediaTek, it secures long‑term financing under the ECB structure to support R&D and business expansion.

More importantly, both sides simultaneously announced an expansion of AI infrastructure, edge AI computing and automotive platform cooperation. Building on the existing NVLink Fusion partnership, MediaTek will deepen ASIC and rack‑level AI system integration, lowering the CSP’s barrier to adopt custom XPU without having to build scale‑up interconnects, memory architecture and rack integration from scratch, giving MediaTek a chance to win more design and system‑integration opportunities.

For ASE Technology: the pre‑payment secures downstream capacity supply. ASE and its U.S. subsidiary AeternZ signed a customer pre‑payment agreement with Nvidia, whereby Nvidia pays up front and ASE reserves test capacity in the United States, recouping the amount gradually as services are delivered. This is not an equity investment nor revenue that can be recognized immediately; it is intended to support early U.S. plant investment, ease cash‑flow pressure and improve visibility of capacity demand.

It is worth noting that on September 17 ASE approved a joint guarantee of up to $300 million to meet a capacity‑building and reservation contract required by its U.S. subsidiary’s customer, indicating the customer originally asked the Taiwanese parent to back the new U.S. plant’s performance.
However, on October 13 ASE announced the cancellation of that guarantee, replacing it with the joint pre‑payment agreement with Nvidia.

The adjustment not only confirms Nvidia as a key customer for U.S. test capacity, but also clarifies the commercial model of cash support and capacity reservation, though it does not bring any further surprise to the market:

ASE’s cooperation with Nvidia has long been deep in core testing services. At its late‑August earnings briefing, ASE said that in the first half of 2025 GPU customers will drive capacity expansion, with ASIC demand added in the second half, and that customer concentration will continue to rise. The 2025 financials later showed the top single customer contributed NT$12.65 billion, or 36% of revenue, more than double the 18% share a year earlier.
(Image source: You Analysis Industry Data Center)

Although the company did not disclose the customer’s identity, Nvidia’s official listing of ASE in the Vera Rubin supply chain and analysts’ reviews of Rubin GPU and Vera CPU test orders lead the market to strongly infer that Nvidia has become ASE’s largest customer, with some analysts estimating Nvidia now accounts for over 50% of ASE’s revenue.
Beyond the market’s expectation of the partnership, the terms of the pre‑payment agreement have not been made public, so the actual risk‑sharing and order‑guarantee levels cannot be verified.
ASE raised its 2026 full‑year capital expenditure in April to NT$50 billion; the U.S. investment cap is $1.4 billion, approved in July and slated for modest operation in 2028.

Nevertheless, as AI chip packaging and power consumption rise, analysts expect testing time, burn‑in and cooling needs to increase in tandem, and ASE’s high‑power testing capability could translate into higher per‑chip test value. Nvidia’s choice to pre‑pay for reserved capacity also highlights the critical role of downstream testing in the supply chain.
Thus, the two deals differ in timing and nature. MediaTek’s story is most imaginative, leveraging Nvidia’s ecosystem to open new customers and products, with ASIC business growth expected to expand;

In contrast, ASE has already been a key Nvidia GPU testing partner, and its U.S. plant and capacity‑reservation plans have long been disclosed. The breakthrough of this pre‑payment agreement lies mainly in confirming Nvidia’s willingness to provide cash support, easing the financing burden of overseas plant construction and securing its own demand, though no further figures or share allocations are disclosed.

ASE has not revealed the pre‑payment amount, minimum purchase volume or profit terms for the U.S. plant; the $1.4 billion figure is merely the investment cap and does not equal Nvidia’s cash commitment. Whether it can boost profitability will depend on the new plant’s utilization, test pricing and cost structure, and its impact on overall earnings as capacity ramps up.
