items.title: 金管會攜銀行公會創新金融！彭金隆提3大期許 加速穩定幣與虛擬資產整合
items.title_en: Financial Supervisory Commission Teams Up with Bankers Association for Innovative Finance! Peng Jin‑long Sets Three Major Expectations to Accelerate Stablecoin and Virtual Asset Integration
paras: 銀行公會第15屆第2次會員代表大會於今（14）日登場，由銀行公會理事長董瑞斌主持，金管會主委彭金隆特別蒞臨致詞。彭金隆在會中高度肯定銀行公會扮演政府與產業溝通橋樑，並對金融業提出三大期許，強調今年前8個月整體銀行業獲利優異，但面對全球經濟不確定性，銀行業應在晴天時廣積糧，持續強化資本強韌度，同時推動信任金融與全齡金融，並落實外部引進與內部培育的雙軌人才戰略，以迎接台灣金融產業高度成長的需要。
彭金隆致詞時首先表達感謝，指出面對國內外經濟劇烈變動與新興科技帶來的挑戰，銀行公會長期全力支持金管會推動各項政策，特別是在協助亞洲資產管理中心專區的私人銀行、家族辦公室及OBU財富管理業務三大工作坊運作上成果顯著，順利推動家族辦公室在台灣落地，為後續法規調適與業務全面推廣打下堅實基礎。
在防詐政策與實體經濟支持方面，彭金隆表示，感謝銀行第一線同仁在阻詐防詐上的無私付出，銀行管理層應給予第一線從業人員最大的支持與鼓勵。此外，目前金融機構對中小企業的放款目標已提前順利達標，期許各銀行未來持續積極協助中小企業發展。針對金融科技與數位轉型，他感謝公會協助研擬穩定幣發行及管理授權子法的建議條文，協助建立穩定幣與虛擬資產的基本監理架構，期待未來能進一步整合傳統金融與區塊鏈金融。
面對金融業未來發展，彭金隆對整體銀行業提出三大明確期許。首先是強化資本結構與資本強韌度，彭金隆指出，今年前8個月整體銀行獲利表現超越前兩年，但在榮景之下更要提高風險意識，銀行業者必須在晴天時廣積糧，持續增強資本結構，唯有資本足夠強大，才能從容因應未來經濟高度成長與潛在市場波動的需要。
其次是推動信任金融、金融大回饋及全齡金融，彭金隆認為銀行擁有良好的經營績效後，應當積極回饋社會、深化社會信任，未來主管機關在金融政策上將有更大幅度的開放，並會持續檢討現行金融服務範圍，儘可能滿足不同族群的需求，尋找新的發展契機。
最後則是全力培養與吸引人才，彭金隆強調，銀行業務的成長完全取決於人才，市場成長必須人才先行，銀行應採用外部引進與內部培育並重的雙軌策略，除了深化本土培育，更要積極吸引國外優秀金融人才，藉此全面提升台灣金融業的國際競爭力。
董瑞斌回應表示，隨著國際經濟與金融情勢快速變化，銀行業面臨的挑戰日趨嚴峻。為配合政策推動台灣成為亞洲資產管理中心，公會已持續研議各項配套措施，修正銀行高資產客戶財富管理業務實務參考文件，並舉辦產業論壇，朝打造具台灣特色的資產管理中心邁進。因應人工智慧與新興科技發展，公會已修訂金融機構運用人工智慧技術作業規範，研提穩定幣授權子法可行建議，並完成量子科技對台灣金融業影響的研究報告。
針對金融安全與防詐，公會協助研擬ATM存入控管措施、修正疑似洗錢交易態樣，並配合研修詐欺犯罪危害防制條例相關子法，透過金檢警跨業聯防與臨櫃關懷，全力守護民眾財產安全。在誠信文化方面，也已研訂銀行業行為與文化管理指引，確保產業穩健經營。
paras_en: The 15th term, 2nd meeting of the Bankers Association’s member representatives was held today (the 14th), chaired by Association chairman Dong Ruibin, with Financial Supervisory Commission (FSC) Chairperson Peng Jin‑long delivering a special address. Peng praised the Association’s role as a bridge between government and industry, and laid out three key expectations for the financial sector, noting that banks posted strong profits in the first eight months of the year but must, amid global economic uncertainty, build reserves in good times, keep strengthening capital resilience, promote trustworthy and all‑age finance, and implement a dual‑track talent strategy of external recruitment and internal development to meet Taiwan’s rapid financial‑industry growth needs.

Peng began his remarks by thanking the Association, pointing out that amid volatile domestic and overseas economies and challenges from emerging technologies, the Bankers Association has consistently supported the FSC’s policy initiatives. He highlighted the Association’s notable contributions to the Asian Asset Management Center’s private‑banking, family‑office and OBU wealth‑management workshops, which have successfully anchored family offices in Taiwan and laid a solid foundation for subsequent regulatory adjustments and broader business rollout.

Regarding anti‑fraud measures and support for the real economy, Peng expressed gratitude for frontline bank staff’s selfless efforts in fraud prevention and urged bank management to give them maximum support and encouragement. He noted that financial institutions have already met their loan‑disbursement targets for SMEs ahead of schedule and called on banks to continue actively assisting SME development. On fintech and digital transformation, he thanked the Association for helping draft the stablecoin issuance and management authorization sub‑law provisions, which establish a basic supervisory framework for stablecoins and virtual assets, and he looks forward to deeper integration of traditional finance with blockchain finance.

Looking ahead, Peng set three clear expectations for the banking sector. First, to strengthen capital structure and resilience. He observed that while banks’ profit performance in the first eight months surpassed that of the previous two years, the sector must heighten risk awareness, stockpile reserves in good times, and continuously enhance capital adequacy so it can comfortably handle future high‑growth economies and market volatility.

Second, to promote trustworthy finance, major financial give‑backs and all‑age finance. Peng argued that once banks achieve solid performance, they should give back to society and deepen public trust. He said regulators will further open up financial policies and continuously review the scope of financial services to meet the needs of diverse groups and seek new development opportunities.

Third, to fully cultivate and attract talent. Peng emphasized that the growth of banking services depends entirely on talent; market expansion must be talent‑driven. Banks should adopt a dual‑track strategy of external recruitment and internal development, deepening local talent pipelines while actively attracting outstanding overseas financial professionals to boost Taiwan’s international competitiveness.

Dong Ruibin responded that rapid changes in the global economy and financial landscape are intensifying challenges for banks. To align with policies positioning Taiwan as an Asian asset‑management hub, the Association has been formulating supporting measures, revising practical reference documents for wealth‑management services to high‑net‑worth clients, and hosting industry forums to build a Taiwan‑characteristic asset‑management centre. In response to AI and emerging technologies, the Association has updated guidelines for AI use by financial institutions, proposed feasible stablecoin authorization sub‑law recommendations, and completed a research report on the impact of quantum technology on Taiwan’s financial sector.

Regarding financial security and fraud prevention, the Association helped draft ATM deposit control measures, revised suspicious money‑laundering transaction patterns, and collaborated on sub‑law development for the Fraud Crime Prevention Act. Through cross‑industry cooperation among the FSC, police and banks and on‑site customer care, it aims to protect the public’s assets. In terms of integrity culture, it has also formulated behavioral and cultural management guidelines for banks to ensure the industry’s sound operation.

items.title: SpaceX發布最強語音AI模型Grok Voice 3.0 搞定七成星鏈客服來電
items.title_en: SpaceX Unveils Its Most Advanced Voice AI Model Grok Voice 3.0, Handling About 70% of Starlink Support Calls
paras: 語音AI競爭從對話能力延伸至客服任務執行。SpaceX 週三 (14日) 推出Grok Voice 3.0，稱新模型已能在無須人工介入的情況下，解決約70%的星鏈(Starlink)客服來電，宣稱是「全球最聰明的語音到語音模型。」
獨立評測平台Artificial Analysis的測試則顯示，該模型以86.9分登上語音到語音綜合指數榜首，但在使用者偏好、部分任務測試及首次回應速度上，並未全面領先。
相較於單純回答問題，Grok Voice的應用已涵蓋實際客服操作。
SpaceX表示，系統每天處理約2萬通星鏈客戶來電，可驗證客戶身分、排查硬體故障、提供帳戶折抵額度，並安排寄送替換設備。經由該系統處理的銷售來電中，每4通就有1通在通話結束前完成購買。
不過，約70%的自主解決率仍屬公司公布的內部應用數據。SpaceX未詳細揭露統計期間、問題類型分布及「自主解決」的判定標準，不能直接據此推算企業可節省的成本。
Grok Voice 3.0綜合成績居冠
Artificial Analysis的語音到語音綜合指數，涵蓋語音推理、代理執行能力、使用者偏好及任務成功率。Grok Voice 3.0得分86.9，較前代的81.3增加5.6分，高於GPT-Live-1的Astra中等推理配置版83.2分，以及Gemini 3.8 Live Extended Thinking高推理配置版82.6分。
在Speech Agent Arena測試中，Grok Voice 3.0以94.8%的任務成功率排名第一，略高於前代的94.6%；Big Bench Audio音訊推理測試得分則達98.5%，高於前代的97.2%。
但其他項目仍有競爭對手領先。Grok Voice 3.0在Tau Voice語音代理執行能力測試中得分71.6%，排名第二，低於GPT-Live-1的Astra中等配置版74.5%。使用者偏好方面，其Elo評分為1070，排名第三，落後Gemini 3.1 Flash Live Minimal的1100及Gemini 3.8 Live的1088。
這些結果顯示，新模型的綜合能力有所提升，但綜合排名居冠，並不代表每項能力或所有實際應用情境都優於競品。
官方稱延遲降低40% 第三方測得首次回應較前代慢
回應速度同樣需要區分指標。SpaceX宣稱，Grok Voice 3.0可在不到1秒內回應，並將延遲降低40%；Artificial Analysis在Big Bench Audio測試中，測得平均首次語音回應時間為0.81秒。
這個速度快於GPT-Live-1的Sol低配置版1.24秒及Astra中等配置版1.34秒，但比Grok Voice 2.0的0.70秒增加0.11秒。
官方所稱的延遲降幅，與第三方測得的首次語音回應時間並不完全對應，可能涉及不同測試場景或計算口徑，不宜直接比較。對企業而言，除了開始回應的速度，模型能否持續理解對話、正確呼叫工具並完成任務，也是部署時的重要考量。
每分鐘0.08美元 維持前代價格
Grok Voice 3.0已透過Voice Agent API及Voice Agent Builder開放使用，定價維持每分鐘0.08美元，相當於每小時4.80美元。既有開發者若使用grok-voice-latest模型別名，將自動切換至3.0，無須修改模型名稱或重新適配整套API介面。
不過，新模型並非所有競品中最便宜的選擇。依Artificial Analysis估算的每小時輸入音訊成本，GPT-Live-1的Sol低配置版為4.47美元，Gemini 3.8 Live Extended Thinking高配置版為3.50美元，均低於Grok Voice 3.0的4.80美元。
因此，這次升級的主要訴求，是在維持前代價格的同時，提高綜合能力與任務完成表現。
同步支援特斯拉車內對話
除了星鏈客服，Grok Voice 3.0也已支援特斯拉(TSLA-US)車內每天數百萬次對話。
依xAI介紹，駕駛可透過Connectors處理行事曆、訊息等日常任務，或透過Grok Bot提出訂咖啡、預約用餐等請求；系統也已整合空調、介面及車輛設定調整。
馬斯克先前曾確認，計畫讓駕駛透過語音啟用全自動輔助駕駛(FSD)相關行為，但這項整合尚未廣泛推出。
從星鏈客服到車內助理，Grok Voice 3.0的部署反映語音AI競爭正轉向實際任務執行。評測成績提供能力比較，企業最終仍須檢視模型在真實業務中的穩定性、複雜問題處理能力及整體成本。
paras_en: Voice AI competition is expanding from conversational ability to executing customer‑service tasks. On Wednesday (the 14th), SpaceX launched Grok Voice 3.0, claiming the new model can resolve roughly 70% of Starlink support calls without human intervention and calling it “the world’s smartest voice‑to‑voice model.”

An independent benchmark platform, Artificial Analysis, reported that the model topped the voice‑to‑voice composite index with a score of 86.9, but it did not lead across user‑preference metrics, some task tests, or first‑response latency.
Compared with merely answering questions, Grok Voice’s use cases now include actual support operations.

SpaceX says the system handles about 20,000 Starlink customer calls per day, can verify caller identity, troubleshoot hardware failures, offer account credit, and arrange shipment of replacement equipment. Of the sales calls processed by the system, one in four is completed with a purchase before the call ends.

However, the roughly 70% autonomous resolution rate comes from internal data disclosed by the company. SpaceX did not detail the measurement period, the distribution of issue types, or the criteria for “autonomous resolution,” so the cost savings for enterprises cannot be directly inferred.
Grok Voice 3.0 Takes the Top Spot in Composite Scores

Artificial Analysis’s voice‑to‑voice composite index covers speech reasoning, agent execution ability, user preference and task success rate. Grok Voice 3.0 scored 86.9, up 5.6 points from the previous version’s 81.3, surpassing GPT‑Live‑1 Astra medium‑reasoning configuration (83.2) and Gemini 3.8 Live Extended Thinking high‑reasoning configuration (82.6).

In the Speech Agent Arena test, Grok Voice 3.0 achieved a 94.8% task‑success rate, ranking first and slightly ahead of the prior version’s 94.6%; in the Big Bench Audio speech‑reasoning test it scored 98.5%, also higher than the previous 97.2%.

Other categories still have competitors ahead. In the Tau Voice agent‑execution test Grok Voice 3.0 scored 71.6%, placing second behind GPT‑Live‑1 Astra medium configuration (74.5%). For user preference, its Elo rating was 1070, third behind Gemini 3.1 Flash Live Minimal (1100) and Gemini 3.8 Live (1088).
These results show the new model’s overall capability has improved, but being top of the composite ranking does not mean it outperforms rivals in every individual ability or real‑world scenario.
Official Claim of 40% Latency Reduction; Third‑Party Test Shows Slightly Slower First Response

Response speed must be broken down by metric. SpaceX claims Grok Voice 3.0 can reply in under one second and has cut latency by 40%; Artificial Analysis measured an average first‑speech response time of 0.81 seconds in the Big Bench Audio test.
That is faster than GPT‑Live‑1 Sol low‑config (1.24 s) and Astra medium‑config (1.34 s), but slower than Grok Voice 2.0’s 0.70 s by 0.11 s.

The latency reduction cited by SpaceX does not map directly onto the third‑party first‑response measurement, likely due to different test scenarios or calculation methods, so direct comparison is inappropriate. For enterprises, beyond initial reply speed, the model’s ability to maintain context, correctly invoke tools and complete tasks matters most for deployment.
$0.08 per Minute, Same Price as the Previous Generation

Grok Voice 3.0 is available through the Voice Agent API and Voice Agent Builder at a price of $0.08 per minute (equivalent to $4.80 per hour). Existing developers using the grok‑voice‑latest model alias will be switched automatically to 3.0 without changing the model name or re‑adapting the API.

However, the new model is not the cheapest option among competitors. According to Artificial Analysis’s estimated hourly input‑audio cost, GPT‑Live‑1 Sol low‑config costs $4.47 per hour and Gemini 3.8 Live Extended Thinking high‑config costs $3.50 per hour, both lower than Grok Voice 3.0’s $4.80.
Thus, the main pitch of this upgrade is to boost overall capability and task performance while keeping the same price as the prior version.
Support for In‑Car Conversations in Tesla Vehicles
Beyond Starlink support, Grok Voice 3.0 also powers hundreds of thousands of daily in‑car conversations for Tesla (TSLA‑US).

According to xAI, drivers can use Connectors to manage calendars, messages and other routine tasks, or ask Grok Bot to order coffee, book a restaurant, etc.; the system is also integrated with climate control, interface and vehicle‑setting adjustments.
Musk previously confirmed plans to let drivers activate full‑self‑driving (FSD) functions via voice, but that integration has not yet been rolled out widely.

From Starlink support to in‑car assistants, the deployment of Grok Voice 3.0 shows that voice AI competition is shifting toward concrete task execution. Benchmark scores provide capability comparisons, but enterprises still need to evaluate model stability, handling of complex issues and overall cost in real‑world operations.

items.title: SpaceX突限制星鏈！烏軍無人機慘遭斷網 多項任務失敗
items.title_en: SpaceX Imposes Limits on Starlink! Ukrainian Drones Suffer Connectivity Loss, Multiple Missions Fail
paras: 烏克蘭官員與軍方週三 (14 日) 指控，馬斯克旗下 SpaceX 未事先通知便對部分星鏈 (Starlink) 服務設限，導致無人機連線中斷、操控困難，多項軍事任務失敗，部分原定行動也被迫取消。烏方已要求美國政府及 SpaceX 說明，但截至報導時尚未收到回覆。
《NBC News》報導，烏克蘭總統澤倫斯基的國防科技顧問Serhii Beskrestnov 表示，SpaceX 前一夜對星鏈終端設備新增速度限制，軍用版本在移動速度超過每小時 100 英里、約 160 公里時受到限制。由於國防部隊事前未獲通知，多項任務因此失敗。
烏克蘭空中突擊部隊第 7 快速反應軍表示，前一夜開始發現星鏈連線因資料傳輸速度限制而出現問題，直接影響依賴這項服務進行飛行操控的無人機。無人機雖仍能飛行，但連線中斷使操控更加困難。
另一支在東南部札波羅熱地區作戰的部隊則表示，已被迫取消部分原定行動。一名烏克蘭官員透露，部分部隊回報，無人機即使以較低速度飛行，性能仍受到影響。
星鏈是烏軍戰場通訊與無人機運作的重要工具。馬斯克在俄羅斯於 2022 年全面入侵後不久，便在烏克蘭啟用這項服務。由於能抵抗訊號干擾，星鏈不僅支援戰場通訊，也讓烏軍得以運用更長程的無人機。
Beskrestnov指出，星鏈同時涉及防空任務，烏方利用這項服務攔截俄羅斯近幾個月用於攻擊烏克蘭城市的噴射動力無人機。烏克蘭駐美代辦謝尼克 (Denys Sienik) 表示，相關技術有助於保護平民生命，減少俄軍攻擊造成的破壞。
一名烏克蘭官員表示，軍方是在發現運作異常並提出申訴後，才從客服得知相關限制，SpaceX 並未事先告知。白宮、SpaceX 及星鏈也未立即回應。
限制措施的原因仍待釐清。Beskrestnov認為，此舉並非巧合，而是與當前政治局勢有關；部分烏方官員也因馬斯克與川普關係密切，質疑措施推出的時機。不過，報導尚未確認服務中斷與政治因素之間的關聯。
這項爭議發生之際，美烏關係正因俄羅斯能源議題持續緊張。川普希望在期中選舉前壓低汽油價格，並與俄羅斯達成柴油交易，改變美國多年來的制裁安排。他隨後要求烏克蘭停止攻擊俄國煉油廠，並呼籲撤換澤倫斯基。
基輔及其支持者擔憂，華府可能中斷戰場支援，迫使烏方在談判桌上讓步。馬斯克今年曾同意停用俄軍在烏克蘭使用的數千個星鏈終端設備，造成俄軍運作困難，但近幾日也呼應川普對烏克蘭的批評。
除星鏈通訊受阻外，烏方也正釐清盟友情資預警的狀況。澤倫斯基表示，基輔週一 (12 日) 與週二 (13 日) 接連遭俄軍彈道飛彈攻擊，兩次均未獲盟友提前警告。他強調，俄軍彈道飛彈發射情報攸關救命，但未點名美國。
針對週一的攻擊，兩名烏克蘭官員告訴《NBC News》，5 枚彈道飛彈在未獲美方提前通知的情況下擊中民用基礎設施，原因是美國情資共享發生技術問題。烏克蘭外長Andrii Sybiha 則表示，美方仍持續分享情報，並將預警延遲歸因於俄軍使用的「特殊類型武器」。
週二再次未獲預警後，官員對原因的說法出現分歧。一名烏方官員認為，連續兩次未獲通知看來並非巧合；另一名官員則歸因於天候不佳。兩名歐洲官員表示，仍在釐清原因。
川普否認扣留攸關烏克蘭防衛的情資，週二向記者表示：「我們正在幫助他們，也正在分享情報。」
烏克蘭空軍發言人Yurii Ihnat 週三也指出，第二次未獲預警的攻擊之後，接下來 3 波攻擊均收到盟友有關彈道武器使用的通知。
paras_en: Ukrainian officials and the military on Wednesday (the 14th) accused Elon Musk's SpaceX of imposing limits on parts of the Starlink service without prior notice, causing drone connections to drop, making control difficult, and leading to the failure of several military missions, with some planned operations forced to be cancelled. Kyiv has asked the U.S. government and SpaceX for an explanation, but had not received a reply at the time of reporting.

NBC News reported that Serhii Beskrestnov, the defence‑technology adviser to President Zelensky, said SpaceX added a speed restriction to Starlink terminals the night before, limiting the military version when moving faster than 100 mph (about 160 km/h). Because the defence forces were not warned in advance, multiple missions failed as a result.

Ukraine’s 7th Rapid Reaction Air Assault Brigade said that the previous night they began noticing problems with Starlink connections due to the data‑transfer speed cap, which directly affected drones that rely on the service for flight control. The drones could still fly, but the loss of connectivity made operating them much harder.

Another unit operating in the southeastern Zaporizhzhia region said it was forced to cancel some planned actions. A Ukrainian official disclosed that some units reported that even when drones flew at lower speeds, performance was still degraded.

Starlink is a critical tool for Ukrainian battlefield communications and drone operations. Musk launched the service in Ukraine shortly after Russia’s full‑scale invasion in 2022. Because it resists signal jamming, Starlink not only supports battlefield communications but also enables the Ukrainian forces to use longer‑range drones.

Beskrestnov noted that Starlink is also used for air‑defence missions, with Ukraine employing the service to intercept Russian jet‑powered drones that have been attacking Ukrainian cities in recent months. Ukrainian envoy to the U.S. Denys Sienik said the technology helps protect civilian lives and reduces damage from Russian attacks.

A Ukrainian official said the military only learned of the restriction from customer support after reporting the anomaly and filing a complaint; SpaceX had not warned them beforehand. The White House, SpaceX and Starlink did not respond immediately.

The reason for the restriction remains unclear. Beskrestnov believes the move is not a coincidence but is tied to the current political climate; some Ukrainian officials, noting Musk’s close ties to former President Trump, question the timing of the measure. However, the report has not confirmed any link between the service outage and political factors.

The dispute comes as U.S.–Ukraine relations are strained over ongoing Russian energy issues. Trump wants to lower gasoline prices before the mid‑term elections and is seeking a diesel deal with Russia, altering years of sanctions. He later urged Ukraine to stop striking Russian refineries and called for Zelensky’s removal.

Kyiv and its supporters fear Washington might cut battlefield support, forcing Ukraine to concede at the negotiating table. Musk earlier this year agreed to deactivate thousands of Starlink terminals used by Russian forces in Ukraine, hampering Russian operations, but in recent days he has echoed Trump’s criticism of Ukraine.

Beyond the Starlink communications disruption, Ukraine is also clarifying the status of allied early‑warning intelligence. Zelensky said Kyiv was hit by Russian ballistic missiles on Monday (the 12th) and Tuesday (the 13th) with no advance warning from allies on either occasion. He stressed that missile launch intelligence is life‑saving, without naming the United States.

Regarding Monday’s attack, two Ukrainian officials told NBC News that five ballistic missiles struck civilian infrastructure without prior U.S. notice because of a technical problem in U.S. intelligence sharing. Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha said the United States continues to share intelligence and blamed the warning delay on a “special type of weapon” used by Russia.

After Tuesday’s lack of warning, officials offered differing explanations. One Ukrainian official said the back‑to‑back failures to receive notice did not appear coincidental; another blamed poor weather. Two European officials said investigations into the cause are ongoing.
Trump denied withholding intelligence relevant to Ukraine’s defence, telling reporters on Tuesday, “We are helping them and we are sharing intelligence.”
Ukrainian Air Force spokesman Yurii Ihnat said on Wednesday that after the second un‑warned attack, the next three strikes did include notifications from allies about the use of ballistic weapons.

items.title: AI財富效應改寫美國家庭資產配置！股票比重超越房市 股市回檔恐衝擊更大
items.title_en: AI Wealth Effect Reshapes U.S. Household Asset Allocation! Stock Share Surpasses Real Estate, Market Pullback Could Hit Harder
paras: 美國股市多頭行情邁入第四年，人工智慧(AI)熱潮推動標普500指數連續多年大幅上漲，也改變美國家庭財富的配置結構。如今，股票在美國家庭總資產中的占比已超過30%，高於房地產約25%的比重。股市與房市走勢日益分歧，不僅反映AI熱潮帶來的財富效應，也凸顯高利率與房價負擔沉重對一般家庭造成的壓力。
《MarketWatch》報導，過去，在美國擁有房屋一向被視為累積世代財富的明確途徑，但隨著住房負擔能力危機持續，房貸利率在9月升破7%，標普500指數連年繳出雙位數漲幅，這條累積財富的傳統道路已不再那麼理所當然。
如今股票不僅超越房地產，成為美國家庭最有價值的資產類別，兩者之間的差距也持續擴大。
穆迪分析(Moody’s Analytics)首席經濟學家Mark Zandi表示：「這是AI對上房市。兩者就像經濟的兩端，AI正在引領前進，但房市卻難以跟上。」

AI推升股市財富 房市卻遭高利率壓制

根據道明證券(TD Securities)引用的數據，目前股票占美國家庭總資產的比重已超過30%，房地產則接近25%。
這種情況在過去並不常見。2000年代中期，房地產占家庭總財富的比重曾超過30%，股票則約為15%。
2008年金融危機後，新屋供給不足，使許多首購族面臨沉重的購屋能力挑戰。接著，2020年新冠疫情爆發，房價飆升，房貸利率一度低至2.65%，美國也經歷近40年來最嚴重的通膨之一。
然而，美國聯準會(Fed)自2022年起升息抗通膨，科技股卻在OpenAI於同年11月推出ChatGPT後開始強勢上漲。美國經濟的房貸利率與借貸成本不斷攀升，但投資人「害怕錯過行情」(FOMO)的情緒，也在少數強勢股票中迅速升溫，尤其是半導體股與大型科技股。
Zandi將AI產業與房市形容為「彼此的鏡像」。他指出，高利率使屋主不願出售既有房屋，並壓抑購屋需求，另一方面，少數大型科技公司大量借款，以支應AI基礎建設投資，迄今至少在一定程度上仍不受高利率影響。
Zandi表示，受益者主要是富裕階層，以及資產大多配置在股票的人。中產階級可能因退休帳戶持有股票而受惠，但借貸成本上升正帶來壓力，而他們的房屋往往是最重要的資產，短期內卻難以大幅增值。
美國10年期公債殖利率9月升破5%後，華爾街部分人士認為，殖利率可能進一步升至6%。10年期公債殖利率是新承作30年期房貸及其他家庭、企業債務的重要定價基準，若進一步攀升，將加重借款人的負擔。
不過，Zandi提醒，沒有任何一種資產類別能永遠領先，因此投資組合仍應維持多元配置。

股市愈來愈像整體經濟 財富集中恐放大市場下跌衝擊

海軍聯邦信用合作社(Navy Federal Credit Union)首席經濟學家Heather Long形容：「股市正愈來愈代表整體經濟。」這也是為什麼股市若出現大幅回檔或進入空頭市場，將對整體經濟造成重大衝擊。以2001年網路泡沫破裂後出現的經濟衰退為例，股市下跌的確可能波及更廣泛的經濟活動。
Long表示，與股市連動的財富持續增加，部分原因在於億萬富豪的財富不斷累積，以及嬰兒潮世代逐漸老去、持有資產持續累積。
這種趨勢也反映在近期較高價住宅的需求上：100萬美元級距的房屋仍吸引買家，但其他房市領域的表現已開始動搖。根據TD Cowen 10月6日發布的房市報告，房價漲幅超越收入成長，也讓民眾更難符合房貸資格。
在這樣的環境下，一些年輕人開始在金融市場追逐高風險、高報酬的投資機會，還有一些人則採取「把握當下」的生活方式，將收入用於旅行與體驗，而非儲蓄。
不過，Long也觀察到另一種趨勢：部分年輕人能在25歲左右就買下房屋。
她以海軍聯邦信用合作社的數據指出，這類購屋者多半是藍領工作者，從事軍職或技術工種，擁有穩定的收入與職涯，且通常居住在生活成本較低的地區。他們也經常利用低頭期款、甚至免頭期款的購屋方案。
Long說：「這種情況仍然少見，在我們的客戶投資組合中占比不到10%，但這反映出有些人在很年輕時就已具備一定程度的財務穩定性。」
paras_en: The U.S. stock market’s bull run has entered its fourth year, with the AI boom driving the S&P 500 to post multi‑year double‑digit gains and reshaping how American families allocate wealth. Today, stocks account for over 30% of total household assets, outpacing real estate’s roughly 25% share. The growing divergence between equities and housing reflects both the wealth‑creating power of AI and the pressure that high rates and costly homes place on typical families.

MarketWatch notes that home ownership has long been seen as a clear path to intergenerational wealth in the United States, but as the housing‑affordability crisis deepens—mortgage rates broke 7% in September—and the S&P 500 continues to deliver double‑digit annual gains, that traditional route is no longer a given.
Now stocks not only eclipse real estate but have become the most valuable asset class for U.S. households, and the gap between the two is widening.
Moody’s Analytics chief economist Mark Zandi said, “This is AI versus the housing market. They sit at opposite ends of the economy—AI is moving forward, while housing can’t keep up.”

AI lifts equity wealth while high rates suppress the housing market. According to data cited by TD Securities, stocks now make up more than 30% of U.S. household total assets, with real estate close to 25%.
Such a split was rare in the past. In the mid‑2000s, real estate accounted for over 30% of household wealth, while stocks were about 15%.

After the 2008 financial crisis, a shortage of new homes left many first‑time buyers facing steep affordability challenges. Then the COVID‑19 pandemic in 2020 sent home prices soaring and mortgage rates fell to as low as 2.65%, while the U.S. experienced one of its worst inflation spells in four decades.

However, the Fed began raising rates in 2022 to combat inflation, and tech stocks surged after OpenAI launched ChatGPT in November of that year. Even as mortgage rates and borrowing costs climb, investor fear of missing out (FOMO) has heated up in a handful of strong stocks, especially semiconductors and large‑cap tech firms.

Zandi describes the AI sector and the housing market as “mirrors of each other.” He points out that high rates discourage homeowners from selling and dampen demand, while a few big tech companies are borrowing heavily to fund AI infrastructure and, to some extent, remain insulated from rate hikes.

Zandi says the primary beneficiaries are the wealthy and those whose portfolios are heavily weighted in equities. The middle class may gain from stock holdings in retirement accounts, but rising borrowing costs create pressure, and their homes—often their biggest asset—are unlikely to see rapid appreciation in the short term.

After the 10‑year Treasury yield broke 5% in September, some Wall Street voices warned it could climb to 6%. The 10‑year yield is a key pricing benchmark for new 30‑year mortgages and other household and corporate debt, and further rises would increase borrowers’ burdens.
Nonetheless, Zandi cautions that no single asset class can stay ahead forever, so portfolios should remain diversified.

The stock market is becoming increasingly representative of the overall economy, and wealth concentration could amplify the impact of a market downturn. Navy Federal Credit Union chief economist Heather Long says, “The stock market is increasingly reflecting the whole economy,” which is why a sharp pullback or bear market could have major macroeconomic repercussions, as seen after the 2001 dot‑com bust.

Long notes that wealth tied to the market keeps growing, driven in part by the continued accumulation of billionaire fortunes and the aging of the baby‑boom generation, whose asset holdings keep expanding.

The trend also shows up in demand for higher‑priced homes: $1 million‑plus houses still attract buyers, but other segments of the market are beginning to wobble. A housing report from TD Cowen released on October 6 found that price gains outpaced income growth, making mortgage qualification harder for many.

In this environment, some younger people are chasing high‑risk, high‑reward opportunities in the financial markets, while others adopt a “live for the moment” mindset, spending income on travel and experiences rather than saving.
Long also observes another pattern: some young adults are able to purchase a home around age 25.

She cites Navy Federal data showing these buyers are mostly blue‑collar workers—military or skilled‑trade employees—with stable incomes and careers, often living in lower‑cost areas, and they frequently use low‑down‑payment or even zero‑down‑payment loan programs.
Long says, “This situation is still rare—less than 10% of our clients’ portfolios—but it shows that some people achieve a degree of financial stability at a very young age.”

items.title: 通膨還高也不急！鮑曼：Fed才升息 可以再看看
items.title_en: Inflation Still High but No Rush: Bowman Says Fed Can Wait Before Raising Rates Again
paras: 聯準會(Fed)負責金融監理的副主席鮑曼(Michelle Bowman)周三(14日)表示，雖然通膨仍高於目標，但央行9月才剛升息，目前沒有迫切需要進一步行動，可先觀察金融情勢與經濟如何演變，再決定下一步。
綜合外媒報導，鮑曼在曼谷出席國際金融協會(IIF)年度會員峰會期間指出：「我目前不覺得有採取進一步行動的急迫性，我們確實需要一些時間，了解情勢將如何發展。」
Fed上月升息1碼，將政策利率區間調高至3.75%至4.00%。鮑曼的觀望立場與近期部分官員一致，副主席傑佛森先前表示，決定是否再次升息前可能需要更多時間；紐約聯準銀行總裁威廉斯也認為無須急於行動，但今年可能仍適合再升息一次。波士頓聯準銀行總裁柯林斯則於周二表示，年底前有必要再次升息，以壓低通膨。
除了利率政策，鮑曼也談及2008年金融危機後的監管問題。她認為，部分資本要求與規範限制成長，並使大量金融活動流出受監管體系，希望透過調整，讓部分業務回流。
針對AI，鮑曼指出，前沿模型可能對關鍵基礎設施構成資安風險；資料中心建設競相籌資，也需要關注銀行及其他來源如何提供資金，確保有足夠資本支撐未來經濟。
她強調，監管仍應讓銀行參與創新。Fed正思考如何將AI納入監理工作，包括了解銀行的使用方式，以及運用AI偵測詐欺的可能性。
鮑曼也表示，在她委託檢討2023年矽谷銀行倒閉事件後，Fed需要「全面重整」監理架構，以改善監管成效並強化內部問責。
paras_en: Federal Reserve Vice Chair for Supervision Michelle Bowman said on Wednesday (the 14th) that although inflation remains above target, the central bank only just raised rates in September and there is no urgent need for further action now; the Fed can first watch how financial conditions and the economy evolve before deciding the next step.

Bowman told reporters at the International Investment Forum’s annual members’ summit in Bangkok that she does not currently feel a sense of urgency to take further action and that the Fed needs some time to see how the situation develops.

The Fed lifted rates by one quarter point last month, moving the policy rate range to 3.75%‑4.00%. Bowman’s wait‑and‑see stance aligns with several recent officials: Vice Chair Jeffers previously said more time may be needed before deciding on another hike; New York Fed President Williams also sees no need to act quickly, though another hike could be appropriate later this year; Boston Fed President Collins said a further hike before year‑end is necessary to bring inflation down.

Beyond rate policy, Bowman discussed post‑2008 financial‑crisis regulatory issues, noting that some capital requirements and rules have constrained growth and pushed a lot of financial activity out of the regulated system, and she hopes adjustments will bring some business back under supervision.

Regarding AI, Bowman warned that cutting‑edge models could pose cybersecurity risks to critical infrastructure; the rush to fund data‑center construction also raises questions about how banks and other sources provide financing, ensuring enough capital to support the future economy.

She stressed that regulation should still allow banks to participate in innovation. The Fed is considering how to incorporate AI into its supervisory work, including understanding how banks use it and the potential for AI‑based fraud detection.

Bowman also said that after she commissioned a review of the 2023 Silicon Valley Bank collapse, the Fed needs a “comprehensive overhaul” of its supervisory framework to improve regulatory effectiveness and strengthen internal accountability.

items.title: 柴油變貴一路傳！Fed褐皮書揭成本壓力 企業預期還會漲價
items.title_en: Diesel Prices Rise Across the Board! Fed Beige Book Reveals Cost Pressures, Companies Expect Further Price Hikes
paras: 聯準會(Fed)周三(14日)公布最新褐皮書指出，美國部分地區物價壓力加劇，柴油與能源成本透過燃料附加費向供應鏈傳導，關稅、其他原物料及保險也持續推高成本。經濟活動整體小幅成長，就業則維持「低招聘、低裁員」格局，凸顯Fed在抑制通膨與評估經濟韌性之間的政策難題。
這份報告由費城聯準銀行彙整，資料蒐集截至10月5日，反映12個轄區企業等受訪者的觀察，並不代表Fed官員立場。報告發布前，同日公布的9月CPI年增3.7%，高於預期，市場對10月27日至28日會議升息的押注升至約37%。

能源成本傳遍供應鏈 企業預期仍有漲價壓力

12個轄區中，3區形容物價漲勢強勁，8區為溫和上漲，其中3區指出投入成本壓力正在加劇，另1區漲幅較小。此外，4個轄區表示，價格上漲速度較前次調查加快。
所有轄區報告均提及油價上升的影響。企業指出，柴油價格居高不下，燃料附加費將成本向供應鏈各環節傳遞；多區也反映，其他原物料、關稅與保險費用仍構成壓力。
不過，面向消費者的企業難以全面轉嫁成本，對價格敏感的顧客持續抗拒漲價，使利潤率受到壓縮。業者因而採取選擇性調價、針對性促銷，以及調整菜單等方式降低成本、維持獲利。
多區企業預期，隨現有合約到期，必須重新議定投入成本的避險合約或對客戶的交付合約，未來數月仍可能進一步漲價。能源與關稅政策的不確定性，也讓企業更難規劃。

成長仰賴製造業與高收入族群 AI影響招聘

經濟活動方面，2個轄區呈現溫和成長、3區小幅成長、4區微幅成長，另3區無明顯變化。達拉斯製造業成長強勁且廣泛，另有6區製造業小幅至溫和擴張，但其他產業整體成長有限。
多數轄區消費支出幾乎沒有變化，逾半數指出消費主要由高收入家庭支撐。即使零售表現穩健的達拉斯，也有低收入顧客更加謹慎的回報；6個提供汽車銷售資訊的轄區中，5區銷量持平至小幅下降。
就業整體變化不大，勞動力供應大致足以滿足需求，但專業、技術及熟練技工仍短缺。5個轄區指出，部分企業投資AI提升生產力後，透過自然流失縮減人力、延後招聘，或預期未來新增就業機會減少。
薪資普遍上升，通膨也帶動員工爭取生活成本調薪，福利成本增加則加重企業負擔。企業對未來數月大致保持正面展望，但多僅預期微幅成長，動能偏重製造業，且仍受持續不確定性牽制。
paras_en: The Federal Reserve released its latest Beige Book on Wednesday (Oct. 14), noting that price pressures are intensifying in parts of the United States. Diesel and energy costs are being passed through the supply chain via fuel surcharges, while tariffs, other raw‑material costs and insurance continue to push expenses higher. Overall economic activity grew modestly, and employment remained in a “low hiring, low layoffs” pattern, highlighting the Fed’s dilemma between curbing inflation and gauging economic resilience.

The report, compiled by the Federal Reserve Bank of Philadelphia, draws on data collected through Oct. 5 from respondents in 12 districts and does not represent the views of Fed officials. It was released the same day that September’s CPI showed a 3.7% year‑over‑year increase, above expectations, raising market odds of a rate hike at the Oct. 27‑28 meeting to about 37%.

Energy costs are rippling through the supply chain, and firms still expect price‑increase pressure. Among the 12 districts, three described price gains as strong, eight saw moderate increases, three said input‑cost pressure is tightening, and one reported a smaller rise. Four districts noted that price growth has accelerated since the previous survey.

All districts mentioned the impact of higher oil prices. Companies said diesel prices remain elevated and fuel surcharges are transmitting costs to every link in the supply chain; many also reported that other raw‑material costs, tariffs and insurance premiums continue to weigh on expenses.

However, firms that sell directly to consumers find it hard to pass on all costs. Price‑sensitive customers keep resisting hikes, squeezing profit margins. As a result, businesses are using selective price adjustments, targeted promotions and menu changes to cut costs and preserve earnings.

Several districts said that as existing contracts expire, firms will have to renegotiate hedging agreements or delivery contracts with customers, meaning further price increases are possible in the coming months. Uncertainty around energy and tariff policy also makes planning more difficult.

Growth relies on manufacturing and high‑income households; AI’s impact on hiring. Regarding economic activity, two districts reported moderate growth, three modest growth, four slight growth and three no clear change. Dallas showed strong, broad‑based manufacturing growth, while six other districts saw manufacturing expand modestly to moderately; growth in other sectors was limited.

Most districts saw consumer spending virtually unchanged, with more than half saying spending is being supported mainly by high‑income families. Even in Dallas, where retail is robust, low‑income customers are becoming more cautious; among six districts that provided auto‑sales data, five reported sales flat to slightly down.

Employment changes were modest overall, with labor supply generally sufficient to meet demand, but shortages persisted for professionals, technicians and skilled trades. Five districts noted that some firms, after investing in AI to boost productivity, are reducing headcount through natural attrition, delaying hires, or expecting fewer new jobs in the future.

Wages are broadly rising, and inflation is prompting workers to seek cost‑of‑living adjustments, while higher benefit costs add to corporate burdens. Companies remain roughly optimistic for the next few months but mostly anticipate only modest growth, with momentum leaning toward manufacturing and still constrained by ongoing uncertainties.

items.title: 客戶開發不安全AI怎麼辦？黃仁勳：會斷供 但先談談
items.title_en: What to Do When Customers Develop Unsafe AI? Jensen Huang: Will Cut Supply but First Talk
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US)執行長黃仁勳表示，若客戶開發不安全的AI軟體，他願意停止供應晶片，但採取行動前會先與對方溝通。他同時認為，目前外界對AI安全的擔憂程度並不合理，產業應加速發展監控與防護技術，讓AI協助管理AI。
黃仁勳在倫敦接受《彭博》記者Emily Chang訪問，被問及是否會停止供貨給不負責任的開發商時回答：「這是假設性問題，但答案是會。」
不過，他隨即補充，斷供之前會先進行對話。「我們不經營別人的公司，對其他公司如何使用我們技術的判斷，也有一定界線。我們的技術是通用的。」
輝達是AI加速器的主要供應商，其晶片廣泛用於訓練與執行AI模型，也使公司成為AI安全辯論的核心角色。外界擔心，AI軟體能力持續增強，可能逐漸脫離人類控制；Anthropic執行長阿莫戴等AI業界領袖，已提出讓整個產業放慢腳步，以處理相關疑慮。
黃仁勳則持不同看法。他目前正在歐洲訪問，之後將出席輝達在柏林舉辦的活動。他認為，AI安全疑慮部分來自產業快速擴張的成長陣痛，並相信這項技術能受到控制，也能安全部署。
為支持AI安全研究，輝達將在五年內提供價值2.5億美元的先進電腦運算使用資源，協助英國研究機構探索相關議題。參與機構包括牛津大學與倫敦大學學院，研究內容涵蓋AI防護措施，以及控制AI代理的方法。
黃仁勳指出，許多年輕公司正以驚人速度成長，也逐步學習承擔建立企業所伴隨的責任與問責要求。他認為，目前部分疑慮是業界自己造成的，而整個產業在向外界解釋新技術好處方面，做得「非常糟糕」。
在他看來，AI本身也能成為防護工具，協助限制與管理這項技術。他主張加快將控制技術整合進AI系統，同時加速開發監控工具。
「AI就是那個監控者，」黃仁勳說，「所以我們應該加速AI技術的發展。」
paras_en: Nvidia (NVDA-US) CEO Jensen Huang said that if a customer develops unsafe AI software, he is willing to stop supplying chips, but will first communicate with the party before taking action. He also believes that the current level of public concern about AI safety is unreasonable, and the industry should accelerate the development of monitoring and protection technologies so that AI can help manage AI.

In an interview with Bloomberg reporter Emily Chang in London, Huang was asked whether Nvidia would stop supplying irresponsible developers and answered, "That's a hypothetical question, but the answer is yes."

He quickly added that a dialogue would precede any cut‑off. "We don't run other companies, and we have clear boundaries on how we judge other firms' use of our technology. Our technology is general‑purpose," he said.

Nvidia is a leading supplier of AI accelerators, with its chips widely used for training and running AI models, making the company a central figure in the AI safety debate. Critics worry that as AI software capabilities grow, they may increasingly slip beyond human control; industry leaders such as Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei have called for the whole sector to slow down to address these concerns.

Huang disagrees. He is currently traveling in Europe and will later attend a Nvidia event in Berlin. He believes that some AI safety worries stem from growing pains of the industry's rapid expansion, and he is confident the technology can be controlled and deployed safely.

To support AI safety research, Nvidia will provide $250 million worth of advanced computing resources over five years to help UK research institutions explore related issues. Participants include the University of Oxford and University College London, with research covering AI protection measures and methods to control AI agents.

Huang noted that many young companies are growing at astonishing speed and are gradually learning to shoulder the responsibilities and accountability that come with building enterprises. He said that part of the current concern is self‑inflicted by the industry, and that the sector has done "a terrible job" of explaining the benefits of new technology to the public.

In his view, AI itself can become a defensive tool to help limit and manage the technology. He advocates speeding up the integration of control mechanisms into AI systems while also accelerating the development of monitoring tools.
"AI is the watchdog," Huang said, "so we should accelerate the development of AI technology."

items.title: 「替美國賺錢！」川普秀格芯投資政績 稱政府持股值逾20億美元
items.title_en: “Making Money for America!” Trump Showcases GlobalFoundries Investment Record, Says Government Stake Worth Over $2 Billion
paras: 美國總統川普周三(14日)在Truth Social發文，宣傳格芯(格羅方德/GlobalFoundries)(GFS-US)在紐約州興建兩座晶片廠的投資案，並強調美國政府另取得格芯股份，稱累計投資16.3億美元後，目前持股價值已超過20億美元，將此形容為「把補助變成替美國賺錢」。
川普表示，格芯與商務部長盧特尼克領導的商務部宣布210億美元投資計畫，將在紐約州馬爾他興建兩座大型半導體製造設施，資金由日本提供。他宣稱，計畫將創造2.7萬個高薪建築與供應鏈以及逾1,000個高技術製造業就業機會。
這項建廠計畫源自日本承諾對美投資5,500億美元的貿易協議。根據稍早公布的安排，日本將提供最高210億美元資金，新廠由美日共同持有，格芯負責興建、營運及技術授權。首座工廠預計2029年投產，第二座的推進時程則須視市場需求而定。
除了建廠案，川普也宣布與格芯達成另一項協議，讓美國納稅人透過政府持有公司股份。商務部將投入9.55億美元，支持矽光子、矽鍺與先進封裝技術，使他所稱的累計投資金額達到16.3億美元。
川普宣稱，美國政府持有的格芯股份目前價值已超過20億美元，並援引政府投資英特爾(INTC-US)的案例，強調其政府正改變過去提供補助的方式，讓美國分享企業成長成果。不過，這項數字是川普所述的持股價值，並不代表政府已出售股份或實現獲利。
格芯執行長Tim Breen稍早向《路透》表示，美國政府將透過另一項協議取得格芯4%股權，使總持股升至約7%。格芯也可將先前《晶片與科學法》補助資金轉用於提升製造能力。
川普在貼文中表示，政府正將日本、南韓與台灣的投資承諾轉化為大型建設計畫，藉此增加半導體與電力供應、強化能源安全並創造就業。他將這些協議稱為能為美國帶來跨世代改變的投資，並再次強調其重振美國工業基礎與國家安全的政策目標。
paras_en: President Donald Trump posted on Truth Social on Wednesday, promoting GlobalFoundries (GFS‑US)’s plan to build two chip factories in New York State and emphasizing that the U.S. government has also acquired shares in the company. He said that after a cumulative investment of $1.63 billion, the government’s stake is now valued at more than $2 billion, describing it as “turning subsidies into money for America.”

Trump stated that GlobalFoundries, together with Commerce Secretary Lutnick, announced a $21 billion investment plan to construct two large semiconductor manufacturing facilities in Malta, New York, with funding provided by Japan. He claimed the project will create 27,000 high‑pay construction and supply‑chain jobs and over 1,000 high‑tech manufacturing positions.

The plant program originates from Japan’s commitment under a $550 billion trade agreement with the United States. Under the newly disclosed arrangement, Japan will provide up to $21 billion, and the new factories will be jointly owned by the U.S. and Japan, with GlobalFoundries responsible for construction, operation and technology licensing. The first fab is expected to start production in 2029, while the timeline for the second will depend on market demand.

In addition to the construction deal, Trump announced another agreement with GlobalFoundries that allows U.S. taxpayers to hold company equity through the government. The Commerce Department will invest $955 million to support silicon photonics, silicon‑germanium and advanced packaging technologies, bringing the total amount he cites to $1.63 billion.

Trump claimed that the government’s GlobalFoundries shareholding is now worth over $2 billion and cited the government’s investment in Intel as an example, stressing that the administration is changing the way subsidies are provided so America can share in corporate growth. However, the $2 billion figure is Trump’s stated valuation and does not indicate that the government has sold any shares or realized a profit.

GlobalFoundries CEO Tim Breen told Reuters that the U.S. government will acquire a 4% equity stake under a separate agreement, raising its total holding to roughly 7%. GlobalFoundries can also reallocate previously awarded CHIPS Act subsidy funds to enhance manufacturing capacity.

In his post, Trump said the government is converting investment commitments from Japan, South Korea and Taiwan into large‑scale construction projects to boost semiconductor and power supply, strengthen energy security and create jobs. He called these agreements “investments that can bring generational change to America” and reiterated his goal of reviving the U.S. industrial base and national security.

items.title: 跳槽還帶走逾百份檔案？OpenAI控前員工向蘋果高層簡報機密
items.title_en: Did a Job Switcher Take Over a Hundred Files? OpenAI Accuses Former Employee of Presenting Confidential Material to Apple Executives
paras: OpenAI與蘋果(AAPL-US)的營業秘密訴訟再添爭議。OpenAI在最新法院文件中指控，一名轉職蘋果的前員工，曾將逾100份涉及未發表產品的檔案傳送至個人帳戶，之後更向蘋果高層簡報該產品。蘋果則表示，未發現證據支持這些指控。
據《路透》報導，OpenAI本周二(13日)向加州聖荷西聯邦法院提交文件，指稱這場面向蘋果高層的簡報發生於數月前。OpenAI並提及蘋果本周推出的HomeView產品，指出蘋果如今也在開發自家AI產品。
OpenAI在文件中表示，非常擔心公司的營業秘密與機密資訊正在蘋果內部流傳，使蘋果工程師能以OpenAI尚未公開的創新成果為基礎，規劃未來產品。
對此，蘋果表示，公司設有相關政策與程序，確保新進員工不會使用前雇主的機密資訊，且未發現證據支持OpenAI的指控。
這份文件是雙方持續進行的營業秘密爭議之一。訴訟最初由蘋果於今年稍早提出，當時蘋果指控，部分員工離職後將公司機密資訊帶往OpenAI的硬體部門；OpenAI已否認相關指控。
如今OpenAI也對蘋果提出類似指控，讓兩家公司圍繞人才流動與未公開硬體資訊的爭議進一步升高。雙方均否認對方指控，目前所述內容仍屬訴訟中的主張。
paras_en: OpenAI and Apple (AAPL-US) have added another controversy to their trade secret lawsuit. In the latest court filing, OpenAI alleges that a former employee who moved to Apple transferred more than 100 files concerning an unreleased product to a personal account, and later presented that product to Apple senior management. Apple says it has found no evidence to support these allegations.

According to Reuters, OpenAI filed documents with the U.S. District Court in San Jose, California on Tuesday the 13th, claiming the presentation to Apple executives took place several months ago. The filing also references Apple’s recently launched HomeView product, noting that Apple is now developing its own AI offerings.

OpenAI’s filing states it is deeply concerned that its trade secrets and confidential information are circulating within Apple, enabling Apple engineers to base future products on OpenAI innovations that have not yet been made public.
Apple responded that it has policies and procedures in place to ensure new hires do not use former employers’ confidential information, and that it has found no evidence supporting OpenAI’s claims.

The document is one of several ongoing trade‑secret disputes between the two companies. The lawsuit was originally filed by Apple earlier this year, accusing some former employees of taking company secrets to OpenAI’s hardware division; OpenAI has denied those allegations.

Now OpenAI has made similar accusations against Apple, raising the stakes in the dispute over talent mobility and undisclosed hardware information. Both sides deny each other’s claims, and the statements described remain allegations within the litigation.

items.title: SpaceX發布最強語音AI模型Grok Voice 3.0 搞定七成星鏈客服來電
items.title_en: SpaceX Unveils Its Most Advanced Voice AI Model Grok Voice 3.0, Handling About 70% of Starlink Support Calls
paras: 語音AI競爭從對話能力延伸至客服任務執行。SpaceX 週三 (14日) 推出Grok Voice 3.0，稱新模型已能在無須人工介入的情況下，解決約70%的星鏈(Starlink)客服來電，宣稱是「全球最聰明的語音到語音模型。」
獨立評測平台Artificial Analysis的測試則顯示，該模型以86.9分登上語音到語音綜合指數榜首，但在使用者偏好、部分任務測試及首次回應速度上，並未全面領先。
相較於單純回答問題，Grok Voice的應用已涵蓋實際客服操作。
SpaceX表示，系統每天處理約2萬通星鏈客戶來電，可驗證客戶身分、排查硬體故障、提供帳戶折抵額度，並安排寄送替換設備。經由該系統處理的銷售來電中，每4通就有1通在通話結束前完成購買。
不過，約70%的自主解決率仍屬公司公布的內部應用數據。SpaceX未詳細揭露統計期間、問題類型分布及「自主解決」的判定標準，不能直接據此推算企業可節省的成本。
Grok Voice 3.0綜合成績居冠
Artificial Analysis的語音到語音綜合指數，涵蓋語音推理、代理執行能力、使用者偏好及任務成功率。Grok Voice 3.0得分86.9，較前代的81.3增加5.6分，高於GPT-Live-1的Astra中等推理配置版83.2分，以及Gemini 3.8 Live Extended Thinking高推理配置版82.6分。
在Speech Agent Arena測試中，Grok Voice 3.0以94.8%的任務成功率排名第一，略高於前代的94.6%；Big Bench Audio音訊推理測試得分則達98.5%，高於前代的97.2%。
但其他項目仍有競爭對手領先。Grok Voice 3.0在Tau Voice語音代理執行能力測試中得分71.6%，排名第二，低於GPT-Live-1的Astra中等配置版74.5%。使用者偏好方面，其Elo評分為1070，排名第三，落後Gemini 3.1 Flash Live Minimal的1100及Gemini 3.8 Live的1088。
這些結果顯示，新模型的綜合能力有所提升，但綜合排名居冠，並不代表每項能力或所有實際應用情境都優於競品。
官方稱延遲降低40% 第三方測得首次回應較前代慢
回應速度同樣需要區分指標。SpaceX宣稱，Grok Voice 3.0可在不到1秒內回應，並將延遲降低40%；Artificial Analysis在Big Bench Audio測試中，測得平均首次語音回應時間為0.81秒。
這個速度快於GPT-Live-1的Sol低配置版1.24秒及Astra中等配置版1.34秒，但比Grok Voice 2.0的0.70秒增加0.11秒。
官方所稱的延遲降幅，與第三方測得的首次語音回應時間並不完全對應，可能涉及不同測試場景或計算口徑，不宜直接比較。對企業而言，除了開始回應的速度，模型能否持續理解對話、正確呼叫工具並完成任務，也是部署時的重要考量。
每分鐘0.08美元 維持前代價格
Grok Voice 3.0已透過Voice Agent API及Voice Agent Builder開放使用，定價維持每分鐘0.08美元，相當於每小時4.80美元。既有開發者若使用grok-voice-latest模型別名，將自動切換至3.0，無須修改模型名稱或重新適配整套API介面。
不過，新模型並非所有競品中最便宜的選擇。依Artificial Analysis估算的每小時輸入音訊成本，GPT-Live-1的Sol低配置版為4.47美元，Gemini 3.8 Live Extended Thinking高配置版為3.50美元，均低於Grok Voice 3.0的4.80美元。
因此，這次升級的主要訴求，是在維持前代價格的同時，提高綜合能力與任務完成表現。
同步支援特斯拉車內對話
除了星鏈客服，Grok Voice 3.0也已支援特斯拉(TSLA-US)車內每天數百萬次對話。
依xAI介紹，駕駛可透過Connectors處理行事曆、訊息等日常任務，或透過Grok Bot提出訂咖啡、預約用餐等請求；系統也已整合空調、介面及車輛設定調整。
馬斯克先前曾確認，計畫讓駕駛透過語音啟用全自動輔助駕駛(FSD)相關行為，但這項整合尚未廣泛推出。
從星鏈客服到車內助理，Grok Voice 3.0的部署反映語音AI競爭正轉向實際任務執行。評測成績提供能力比較，企業最終仍須檢視模型在真實業務中的穩定性、複雜問題處理能力及整體成本。
paras_en: Voice AI competition is expanding from conversational ability to executing customer‑service tasks. On Wednesday (the 14th), SpaceX launched Grok Voice 3.0, claiming the new model can resolve roughly 70% of Starlink support calls without human intervention and calling it “the world’s smartest voice‑to‑voice model.”

An independent benchmark platform, Artificial Analysis, reported that the model topped the voice‑to‑voice composite index with a score of 86.9, but it did not lead across user‑preference metrics, some task tests, or first‑response latency.
Compared with merely answering questions, Grok Voice’s use cases now include actual support operations.

SpaceX says the system handles about 20,000 Starlink customer calls per day, can verify caller identity, troubleshoot hardware failures, offer account credit, and arrange shipment of replacement equipment. Of the sales calls processed by the system, one in four is completed with a purchase before the call ends.

However, the roughly 70% autonomous resolution rate comes from internal data disclosed by the company. SpaceX did not detail the measurement period, the distribution of issue types, or the criteria for “autonomous resolution,” so the cost savings for enterprises cannot be directly inferred.
Grok Voice 3.0 Takes the Top Spot in Composite Scores

Artificial Analysis’s voice‑to‑voice composite index covers speech reasoning, agent execution ability, user preference and task success rate. Grok Voice 3.0 scored 86.9, up 5.6 points from the previous version’s 81.3, surpassing GPT‑Live‑1 Astra medium‑reasoning configuration (83.2) and Gemini 3.8 Live Extended Thinking high‑reasoning configuration (82.6).

In the Speech Agent Arena test, Grok Voice 3.0 achieved a 94.8% task‑success rate, ranking first and slightly ahead of the prior version’s 94.6%; in the Big Bench Audio speech‑reasoning test it scored 98.5%, also higher than the previous 97.2%.

Other categories still have competitors ahead. In the Tau Voice agent‑execution test Grok Voice 3.0 scored 71.6%, placing second behind GPT‑Live‑1 Astra medium configuration (74.5%). For user preference, its Elo rating was 1070, third behind Gemini 3.1 Flash Live Minimal (1100) and Gemini 3.8 Live (1088).
These results show the new model’s overall capability has improved, but being top of the composite ranking does not mean it outperforms rivals in every individual ability or real‑world scenario.
Official Claim of 40% Latency Reduction; Third‑Party Test Shows Slightly Slower First Response

Response speed must be broken down by metric. SpaceX claims Grok Voice 3.0 can reply in under one second and has cut latency by 40%; Artificial Analysis measured an average first‑speech response time of 0.81 seconds in the Big Bench Audio test.
That is faster than GPT‑Live‑1 Sol low‑config (1.24 s) and Astra medium‑config (1.34 s), but slower than Grok Voice 2.0’s 0.70 s by 0.11 s.

The latency reduction cited by SpaceX does not map directly onto the third‑party first‑response measurement, likely due to different test scenarios or calculation methods, so direct comparison is inappropriate. For enterprises, beyond initial reply speed, the model’s ability to maintain context, correctly invoke tools and complete tasks matters most for deployment.
$0.08 per Minute, Same Price as the Previous Generation

Grok Voice 3.0 is available through the Voice Agent API and Voice Agent Builder at a price of $0.08 per minute (equivalent to $4.80 per hour). Existing developers using the grok‑voice‑latest model alias will be switched automatically to 3.0 without changing the model name or re‑adapting the API.

However, the new model is not the cheapest option among competitors. According to Artificial Analysis’s estimated hourly input‑audio cost, GPT‑Live‑1 Sol low‑config costs $4.47 per hour and Gemini 3.8 Live Extended Thinking high‑config costs $3.50 per hour, both lower than Grok Voice 3.0’s $4.80.
Thus, the main pitch of this upgrade is to boost overall capability and task performance while keeping the same price as the prior version.
Support for In‑Car Conversations in Tesla Vehicles
Beyond Starlink support, Grok Voice 3.0 also powers hundreds of thousands of daily in‑car conversations for Tesla (TSLA‑US).

According to xAI, drivers can use Connectors to manage calendars, messages and other routine tasks, or ask Grok Bot to order coffee, book a restaurant, etc.; the system is also integrated with climate control, interface and vehicle‑setting adjustments.
Musk previously confirmed plans to let drivers activate full‑self‑driving (FSD) functions via voice, but that integration has not yet been rolled out widely.

From Starlink support to in‑car assistants, the deployment of Grok Voice 3.0 shows that voice AI competition is shifting toward concrete task execution. Benchmark scores provide capability comparisons, but enterprises still need to evaluate model stability, handling of complex issues and overall cost in real‑world operations.

items.title: SpaceX突限制星鏈！烏軍無人機慘遭斷網 多項任務失敗
items.title_en: SpaceX Imposes Limits on Starlink! Ukrainian Drones Suffer Connectivity Loss, Multiple Missions Fail
paras: 烏克蘭官員與軍方週三 (14 日) 指控，馬斯克旗下 SpaceX 未事先通知便對部分星鏈 (Starlink) 服務設限，導致無人機連線中斷、操控困難，多項軍事任務失敗，部分原定行動也被迫取消。烏方已要求美國政府及 SpaceX 說明，但截至報導時尚未收到回覆。
《NBC News》報導，烏克蘭總統澤倫斯基的國防科技顧問Serhii Beskrestnov 表示，SpaceX 前一夜對星鏈終端設備新增速度限制，軍用版本在移動速度超過每小時 100 英里、約 160 公里時受到限制。由於國防部隊事前未獲通知，多項任務因此失敗。
烏克蘭空中突擊部隊第 7 快速反應軍表示，前一夜開始發現星鏈連線因資料傳輸速度限制而出現問題，直接影響依賴這項服務進行飛行操控的無人機。無人機雖仍能飛行，但連線中斷使操控更加困難。
另一支在東南部札波羅熱地區作戰的部隊則表示，已被迫取消部分原定行動。一名烏克蘭官員透露，部分部隊回報，無人機即使以較低速度飛行，性能仍受到影響。
星鏈是烏軍戰場通訊與無人機運作的重要工具。馬斯克在俄羅斯於 2022 年全面入侵後不久，便在烏克蘭啟用這項服務。由於能抵抗訊號干擾，星鏈不僅支援戰場通訊，也讓烏軍得以運用更長程的無人機。
Beskrestnov指出，星鏈同時涉及防空任務，烏方利用這項服務攔截俄羅斯近幾個月用於攻擊烏克蘭城市的噴射動力無人機。烏克蘭駐美代辦謝尼克 (Denys Sienik) 表示，相關技術有助於保護平民生命，減少俄軍攻擊造成的破壞。
一名烏克蘭官員表示，軍方是在發現運作異常並提出申訴後，才從客服得知相關限制，SpaceX 並未事先告知。白宮、SpaceX 及星鏈也未立即回應。
限制措施的原因仍待釐清。Beskrestnov認為，此舉並非巧合，而是與當前政治局勢有關；部分烏方官員也因馬斯克與川普關係密切，質疑措施推出的時機。不過，報導尚未確認服務中斷與政治因素之間的關聯。
這項爭議發生之際，美烏關係正因俄羅斯能源議題持續緊張。川普希望在期中選舉前壓低汽油價格，並與俄羅斯達成柴油交易，改變美國多年來的制裁安排。他隨後要求烏克蘭停止攻擊俄國煉油廠，並呼籲撤換澤倫斯基。
基輔及其支持者擔憂，華府可能中斷戰場支援，迫使烏方在談判桌上讓步。馬斯克今年曾同意停用俄軍在烏克蘭使用的數千個星鏈終端設備，造成俄軍運作困難，但近幾日也呼應川普對烏克蘭的批評。
除星鏈通訊受阻外，烏方也正釐清盟友情資預警的狀況。澤倫斯基表示，基輔週一 (12 日) 與週二 (13 日) 接連遭俄軍彈道飛彈攻擊，兩次均未獲盟友提前警告。他強調，俄軍彈道飛彈發射情報攸關救命，但未點名美國。
針對週一的攻擊，兩名烏克蘭官員告訴《NBC News》，5 枚彈道飛彈在未獲美方提前通知的情況下擊中民用基礎設施，原因是美國情資共享發生技術問題。烏克蘭外長Andrii Sybiha 則表示，美方仍持續分享情報，並將預警延遲歸因於俄軍使用的「特殊類型武器」。
週二再次未獲預警後，官員對原因的說法出現分歧。一名烏方官員認為，連續兩次未獲通知看來並非巧合；另一名官員則歸因於天候不佳。兩名歐洲官員表示，仍在釐清原因。
川普否認扣留攸關烏克蘭防衛的情資，週二向記者表示：「我們正在幫助他們，也正在分享情報。」
烏克蘭空軍發言人Yurii Ihnat 週三也指出，第二次未獲預警的攻擊之後，接下來 3 波攻擊均收到盟友有關彈道武器使用的通知。
paras_en: Ukrainian officials and the military on Wednesday (the 14th) accused Elon Musk's SpaceX of imposing limits on parts of the Starlink service without prior notice, causing drone connections to drop, making control difficult, and leading to the failure of several military missions, with some planned operations forced to be cancelled. Kyiv has asked the U.S. government and SpaceX for an explanation, but had not received a reply at the time of reporting.

NBC News reported that Serhii Beskrestnov, the defence‑technology adviser to President Zelensky, said SpaceX added a speed restriction to Starlink terminals the night before, limiting the military version when moving faster than 100 mph (about 160 km/h). Because the defence forces were not warned in advance, multiple missions failed as a result.

Ukraine’s 7th Rapid Reaction Air Assault Brigade said that the previous night they began noticing problems with Starlink connections due to the data‑transfer speed cap, which directly affected drones that rely on the service for flight control. The drones could still fly, but the loss of connectivity made operating them much harder.

Another unit operating in the southeastern Zaporizhzhia region said it was forced to cancel some planned actions. A Ukrainian official disclosed that some units reported that even when drones flew at lower speeds, performance was still degraded.

Starlink is a critical tool for Ukrainian battlefield communications and drone operations. Musk launched the service in Ukraine shortly after Russia’s full‑scale invasion in 2022. Because it resists signal jamming, Starlink not only supports battlefield communications but also enables the Ukrainian forces to use longer‑range drones.

Beskrestnov noted that Starlink is also used for air‑defence missions, with Ukraine employing the service to intercept Russian jet‑powered drones that have been attacking Ukrainian cities in recent months. Ukrainian envoy to the U.S. Denys Sienik said the technology helps protect civilian lives and reduces damage from Russian attacks.

A Ukrainian official said the military only learned of the restriction from customer support after reporting the anomaly and filing a complaint; SpaceX had not warned them beforehand. The White House, SpaceX and Starlink did not respond immediately.

The reason for the restriction remains unclear. Beskrestnov believes the move is not a coincidence but is tied to the current political climate; some Ukrainian officials, noting Musk’s close ties to former President Trump, question the timing of the measure. However, the report has not confirmed any link between the service outage and political factors.

The dispute comes as U.S.–Ukraine relations are strained over ongoing Russian energy issues. Trump wants to lower gasoline prices before the mid‑term elections and is seeking a diesel deal with Russia, altering years of sanctions. He later urged Ukraine to stop striking Russian refineries and called for Zelensky’s removal.

Kyiv and its supporters fear Washington might cut battlefield support, forcing Ukraine to concede at the negotiating table. Musk earlier this year agreed to deactivate thousands of Starlink terminals used by Russian forces in Ukraine, hampering Russian operations, but in recent days he has echoed Trump’s criticism of Ukraine.

Beyond the Starlink communications disruption, Ukraine is also clarifying the status of allied early‑warning intelligence. Zelensky said Kyiv was hit by Russian ballistic missiles on Monday (the 12th) and Tuesday (the 13th) with no advance warning from allies on either occasion. He stressed that missile launch intelligence is life‑saving, without naming the United States.

Regarding Monday’s attack, two Ukrainian officials told NBC News that five ballistic missiles struck civilian infrastructure without prior U.S. notice because of a technical problem in U.S. intelligence sharing. Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha said the United States continues to share intelligence and blamed the warning delay on a “special type of weapon” used by Russia.

After Tuesday’s lack of warning, officials offered differing explanations. One Ukrainian official said the back‑to‑back failures to receive notice did not appear coincidental; another blamed poor weather. Two European officials said investigations into the cause are ongoing.
Trump denied withholding intelligence relevant to Ukraine’s defence, telling reporters on Tuesday, “We are helping them and we are sharing intelligence.”
Ukrainian Air Force spokesman Yurii Ihnat said on Wednesday that after the second un‑warned attack, the next three strikes did include notifications from allies about the use of ballistic weapons.

items.title: AI財富效應改寫美國家庭資產配置！股票比重超越房市 股市回檔恐衝擊更大
items.title_en: AI Wealth Effect Reshapes U.S. Household Asset Allocation! Stock Share Surpasses Real Estate, Market Pullback Could Hit Harder
paras: 美國股市多頭行情邁入第四年，人工智慧(AI)熱潮推動標普500指數連續多年大幅上漲，也改變美國家庭財富的配置結構。如今，股票在美國家庭總資產中的占比已超過30%，高於房地產約25%的比重。股市與房市走勢日益分歧，不僅反映AI熱潮帶來的財富效應，也凸顯高利率與房價負擔沉重對一般家庭造成的壓力。
《MarketWatch》報導，過去，在美國擁有房屋一向被視為累積世代財富的明確途徑，但隨著住房負擔能力危機持續，房貸利率在9月升破7%，標普500指數連年繳出雙位數漲幅，這條累積財富的傳統道路已不再那麼理所當然。
如今股票不僅超越房地產，成為美國家庭最有價值的資產類別，兩者之間的差距也持續擴大。
穆迪分析(Moody’s Analytics)首席經濟學家Mark Zandi表示：「這是AI對上房市。兩者就像經濟的兩端，AI正在引領前進，但房市卻難以跟上。」

AI推升股市財富 房市卻遭高利率壓制

根據道明證券(TD Securities)引用的數據，目前股票占美國家庭總資產的比重已超過30%，房地產則接近25%。
這種情況在過去並不常見。2000年代中期，房地產占家庭總財富的比重曾超過30%，股票則約為15%。
2008年金融危機後，新屋供給不足，使許多首購族面臨沉重的購屋能力挑戰。接著，2020年新冠疫情爆發，房價飆升，房貸利率一度低至2.65%，美國也經歷近40年來最嚴重的通膨之一。
然而，美國聯準會(Fed)自2022年起升息抗通膨，科技股卻在OpenAI於同年11月推出ChatGPT後開始強勢上漲。美國經濟的房貸利率與借貸成本不斷攀升，但投資人「害怕錯過行情」(FOMO)的情緒，也在少數強勢股票中迅速升溫，尤其是半導體股與大型科技股。
Zandi將AI產業與房市形容為「彼此的鏡像」。他指出，高利率使屋主不願出售既有房屋，並壓抑購屋需求，另一方面，少數大型科技公司大量借款，以支應AI基礎建設投資，迄今至少在一定程度上仍不受高利率影響。
Zandi表示，受益者主要是富裕階層，以及資產大多配置在股票的人。中產階級可能因退休帳戶持有股票而受惠，但借貸成本上升正帶來壓力，而他們的房屋往往是最重要的資產，短期內卻難以大幅增值。
美國10年期公債殖利率9月升破5%後，華爾街部分人士認為，殖利率可能進一步升至6%。10年期公債殖利率是新承作30年期房貸及其他家庭、企業債務的重要定價基準，若進一步攀升，將加重借款人的負擔。
不過，Zandi提醒，沒有任何一種資產類別能永遠領先，因此投資組合仍應維持多元配置。

股市愈來愈像整體經濟 財富集中恐放大市場下跌衝擊

海軍聯邦信用合作社(Navy Federal Credit Union)首席經濟學家Heather Long形容：「股市正愈來愈代表整體經濟。」這也是為什麼股市若出現大幅回檔或進入空頭市場，將對整體經濟造成重大衝擊。以2001年網路泡沫破裂後出現的經濟衰退為例，股市下跌的確可能波及更廣泛的經濟活動。
Long表示，與股市連動的財富持續增加，部分原因在於億萬富豪的財富不斷累積，以及嬰兒潮世代逐漸老去、持有資產持續累積。
這種趨勢也反映在近期較高價住宅的需求上：100萬美元級距的房屋仍吸引買家，但其他房市領域的表現已開始動搖。根據TD Cowen 10月6日發布的房市報告，房價漲幅超越收入成長，也讓民眾更難符合房貸資格。
在這樣的環境下，一些年輕人開始在金融市場追逐高風險、高報酬的投資機會，還有一些人則採取「把握當下」的生活方式，將收入用於旅行與體驗，而非儲蓄。
不過，Long也觀察到另一種趨勢：部分年輕人能在25歲左右就買下房屋。
她以海軍聯邦信用合作社的數據指出，這類購屋者多半是藍領工作者，從事軍職或技術工種，擁有穩定的收入與職涯，且通常居住在生活成本較低的地區。他們也經常利用低頭期款、甚至免頭期款的購屋方案。
Long說：「這種情況仍然少見，在我們的客戶投資組合中占比不到10%，但這反映出有些人在很年輕時就已具備一定程度的財務穩定性。」
paras_en: The U.S. stock market’s bull run has entered its fourth year, with the AI boom driving the S&P 500 to post multi‑year double‑digit gains and reshaping how American families allocate wealth. Today, stocks account for over 30% of total household assets, outpacing real estate’s roughly 25% share. The growing divergence between equities and housing reflects both the wealth‑creating power of AI and the pressure that high rates and costly homes place on typical families.

MarketWatch notes that home ownership has long been seen as a clear path to intergenerational wealth in the United States, but as the housing‑affordability crisis deepens—mortgage rates broke 7% in September—and the S&P 500 continues to deliver double‑digit annual gains, that traditional route is no longer a given.
Now stocks not only eclipse real estate but have become the most valuable asset class for U.S. households, and the gap between the two is widening.
Moody’s Analytics chief economist Mark Zandi said, “This is AI versus the housing market. They sit at opposite ends of the economy—AI is moving forward, while housing can’t keep up.”

AI lifts equity wealth while high rates suppress the housing market. According to data cited by TD Securities, stocks now make up more than 30% of U.S. household total assets, with real estate close to 25%.
Such a split was rare in the past. In the mid‑2000s, real estate accounted for over 30% of household wealth, while stocks were about 15%.

After the 2008 financial crisis, a shortage of new homes left many first‑time buyers facing steep affordability challenges. Then the COVID‑19 pandemic in 2020 sent home prices soaring and mortgage rates fell to as low as 2.65%, while the U.S. experienced one of its worst inflation spells in four decades.

However, the Fed began raising rates in 2022 to combat inflation, and tech stocks surged after OpenAI launched ChatGPT in November of that year. Even as mortgage rates and borrowing costs climb, investor fear of missing out (FOMO) has heated up in a handful of strong stocks, especially semiconductors and large‑cap tech firms.

Zandi describes the AI sector and the housing market as “mirrors of each other.” He points out that high rates discourage homeowners from selling and dampen demand, while a few big tech companies are borrowing heavily to fund AI infrastructure and, to some extent, remain insulated from rate hikes.

Zandi says the primary beneficiaries are the wealthy and those whose portfolios are heavily weighted in equities. The middle class may gain from stock holdings in retirement accounts, but rising borrowing costs create pressure, and their homes—often their biggest asset—are unlikely to see rapid appreciation in the short term.

After the 10‑year Treasury yield broke 5% in September, some Wall Street voices warned it could climb to 6%. The 10‑year yield is a key pricing benchmark for new 30‑year mortgages and other household and corporate debt, and further rises would increase borrowers’ burdens.
Nonetheless, Zandi cautions that no single asset class can stay ahead forever, so portfolios should remain diversified.

The stock market is becoming increasingly representative of the overall economy, and wealth concentration could amplify the impact of a market downturn. Navy Federal Credit Union chief economist Heather Long says, “The stock market is increasingly reflecting the whole economy,” which is why a sharp pullback or bear market could have major macroeconomic repercussions, as seen after the 2001 dot‑com bust.

Long notes that wealth tied to the market keeps growing, driven in part by the continued accumulation of billionaire fortunes and the aging of the baby‑boom generation, whose asset holdings keep expanding.

The trend also shows up in demand for higher‑priced homes: $1 million‑plus houses still attract buyers, but other segments of the market are beginning to wobble. A housing report from TD Cowen released on October 6 found that price gains outpaced income growth, making mortgage qualification harder for many.

In this environment, some younger people are chasing high‑risk, high‑reward opportunities in the financial markets, while others adopt a “live for the moment” mindset, spending income on travel and experiences rather than saving.
Long also observes another pattern: some young adults are able to purchase a home around age 25.

She cites Navy Federal data showing these buyers are mostly blue‑collar workers—military or skilled‑trade employees—with stable incomes and careers, often living in lower‑cost areas, and they frequently use low‑down‑payment or even zero‑down‑payment loan programs.
Long says, “This situation is still rare—less than 10% of our clients’ portfolios—but it shows that some people achieve a degree of financial stability at a very young age.”

items.title: 通膨還高也不急！鮑曼：Fed才升息 可以再看看
items.title_en: Inflation Still High but No Rush: Bowman Says Fed Can Wait Before Raising Rates Again
paras: 聯準會(Fed)負責金融監理的副主席鮑曼(Michelle Bowman)周三(14日)表示，雖然通膨仍高於目標，但央行9月才剛升息，目前沒有迫切需要進一步行動，可先觀察金融情勢與經濟如何演變，再決定下一步。
綜合外媒報導，鮑曼在曼谷出席國際金融協會(IIF)年度會員峰會期間指出：「我目前不覺得有採取進一步行動的急迫性，我們確實需要一些時間，了解情勢將如何發展。」
Fed上月升息1碼，將政策利率區間調高至3.75%至4.00%。鮑曼的觀望立場與近期部分官員一致，副主席傑佛森先前表示，決定是否再次升息前可能需要更多時間；紐約聯準銀行總裁威廉斯也認為無須急於行動，但今年可能仍適合再升息一次。波士頓聯準銀行總裁柯林斯則於周二表示，年底前有必要再次升息，以壓低通膨。
除了利率政策，鮑曼也談及2008年金融危機後的監管問題。她認為，部分資本要求與規範限制成長，並使大量金融活動流出受監管體系，希望透過調整，讓部分業務回流。
針對AI，鮑曼指出，前沿模型可能對關鍵基礎設施構成資安風險；資料中心建設競相籌資，也需要關注銀行及其他來源如何提供資金，確保有足夠資本支撐未來經濟。
她強調，監管仍應讓銀行參與創新。Fed正思考如何將AI納入監理工作，包括了解銀行的使用方式，以及運用AI偵測詐欺的可能性。
鮑曼也表示，在她委託檢討2023年矽谷銀行倒閉事件後，Fed需要「全面重整」監理架構，以改善監管成效並強化內部問責。
paras_en: Federal Reserve Vice Chair for Supervision Michelle Bowman said on Wednesday (the 14th) that although inflation remains above target, the central bank only just raised rates in September and there is no urgent need for further action now; the Fed can first watch how financial conditions and the economy evolve before deciding the next step.

Bowman told reporters at the International Investment Forum’s annual members’ summit in Bangkok that she does not currently feel a sense of urgency to take further action and that the Fed needs some time to see how the situation develops.

The Fed lifted rates by one quarter point last month, moving the policy rate range to 3.75%‑4.00%. Bowman’s wait‑and‑see stance aligns with several recent officials: Vice Chair Jeffers previously said more time may be needed before deciding on another hike; New York Fed President Williams also sees no need to act quickly, though another hike could be appropriate later this year; Boston Fed President Collins said a further hike before year‑end is necessary to bring inflation down.

Beyond rate policy, Bowman discussed post‑2008 financial‑crisis regulatory issues, noting that some capital requirements and rules have constrained growth and pushed a lot of financial activity out of the regulated system, and she hopes adjustments will bring some business back under supervision.

Regarding AI, Bowman warned that cutting‑edge models could pose cybersecurity risks to critical infrastructure; the rush to fund data‑center construction also raises questions about how banks and other sources provide financing, ensuring enough capital to support the future economy.

She stressed that regulation should still allow banks to participate in innovation. The Fed is considering how to incorporate AI into its supervisory work, including understanding how banks use it and the potential for AI‑based fraud detection.

Bowman also said that after she commissioned a review of the 2023 Silicon Valley Bank collapse, the Fed needs a “comprehensive overhaul” of its supervisory framework to improve regulatory effectiveness and strengthen internal accountability.

items.title_en: Taiwan Dollar: Market Awaits TSMC Ahead of Earnings Call, FX Market Swings 0.15 TWD and Edges Up 0.012 TWD
paras: 觀望美國關鍵消費者物價指數(CPI)報告發布，加上台積電 (2330-TW) (TSM-US) 法說會前夕市場觀望氣氛濃厚，新台幣兌美元匯率今(14)日呈現震盪整理走勢。早盤隨台股開高帶動一度反彈，但隨後外資持續在台股提款並匯出，新台幣升幅逐步收斂，全天高低震盪波動，高低震盪達1.5角，持續在32元整數關卡上演攻防戰，最終以微升1.2分的32.073元兌 1 美元作收。

台北外匯市場新台幣兌美元匯率今日以32.060元開盤，微升2.5分；盤中在台股衝高與出口商拋匯帶動下，最高一度升至32.010元，隨後在外資匯出賣壓湧現下由升轉跌，最低下探至32.160元，高低震盪達1.5角；終場升幅大幅收斂，收在32.073元，微升1.2分，升幅約0.04%。台北外匯市場成交金額為22.24億美元，元太外匯市場成交金額為11.595億美元，兩市合計總成交量達33.835億美元，顯示匯市交投氣氛依然十分熱絡。
從國際匯市來看，美元指數自先前高檔溫和回落，目前在102點附近進行盤整。由於市場正密切關注即將公佈的美國通膨數據，以及美聯儲（Fed）未來降息路徑，國際主要貨幣包含歐元與日元呈現窄幅震盪。歐美主要股市高檔整理，亞洲股市今日則出現洗盤格局，整體國際資金流向仍受到總體經濟數據影響。
國內股市方面，台股今日高低波動劇烈，早盤在台積電及半導體族群衝高帶動下，一度大漲超過700點，一舉衝上49000點大關。然而，高檔獲利了結賣壓傾巢而出，尾盤漲幅明顯收斂，終場上漲284.52點，收在48625.83點，成交量放大至9286.24億元，大盤留長上影線。
籌碼面部分，台北外匯與股票市場連動密切，三大法人今日在台股合計賣超153.97億元。其中，外資持續站在賣方，單日賣超約159億元，已連續六個交易日呈現淨賣超，持續將資金匯出；自營商亦順勢調節；僅有投信獨自力挺台股，逆勢加碼買超161.11億元
paras_en: The market is in a watchful mood ahead of the release of the key U.S. Consumer Price Index (CPI) report and TSMC’s (2330‑TW) (TSM‑US) earnings briefing. The New Taiwan dollar (NTD) against the U.S. dollar showed a volatile, consolidating pattern on the 14th. It rose early in the session as the Taiwan stock market opened higher, but foreign investors continued to pull money out of Taiwanese equities and remit it abroad, gradually narrowing the NTD’s gains. Throughout the day the rate oscillated within a 0.15‑NTD range, battling around the 32‑NTD whole‑number level, and closed modestly higher at 32.073 NTD per US$, a rise of 0.012 NTD.

In the Taipei foreign‑exchange market the NTD opened at 32.060 NTD per US$, up 0.025 NTD. Mid‑session, buoyed by a rally in Taiwanese equities and exporters selling foreign currency, the rate briefly climbed to 32.010 NTD before foreign‑exchange outflows exerted selling pressure, turning the move into a decline that pushed the low to 32.160 NTD – a 0.15‑NTD swing. The session’s gain narrowed sharply, ending at 32.073 NTD, up 0.012 NTD (about 0.04%). Taipei’s FX market saw a turnover of US$2.224 billion, while the Yuan‑Tai market handled US$1.1595 billion, for a combined volume of US$3.3835 billion, indicating that trading activity remains robust.

On the global FX front, the U.S. dollar index has slipped modestly from its recent highs and is now consolidating around the 102‑point level. Markets are closely watching the upcoming U.S. inflation data and the Federal Reserve’s future rate‑cut path, keeping major currencies such as the euro and yen in a narrow‑range oscillation. European and U.S. equity markets are trimming gains at elevated levels, while Asian markets displayed a shake‑out pattern today; overall international capital flows continue to be shaped by macroeconomic data.

Domestically, Taiwan’s stock market experienced sharp swings. Early in the session, TSMC and other semiconductor stocks drove the index up more than 700 points, propelling it past the 49,000‑point milestone. However, profit‑taking pressure at the top led to a wave of selling, and the rally tapered off toward the close. The index finished up 284.52 points at 48,625.83, with turnover expanding to NT$928.624 billion and a pronounced upper shadow on the chart.

In terms of market participants, the Taipei FX and equity markets moved in tandem. The three major institutional investors posted a net sell of NT$15.397 billion in equities today. Foreign investors remained on the sell side, offloading about NT$15.9 billion—a sixth consecutive day of net selling as they continue to remit funds abroad. Proprietary traders also adjusted their positions downward, while only investment trusts stood out by buying net NT$16.111 billion of shares, counter‑trend to the overall sell pressure.

items.title: 防範長期劇烈貶值 土耳其央行擬微調匯率政策加快里拉貶值步調
items.title_en: Preventing Long‑Term Sharp Depreciation: Turkey’s Central Bank Plans to Fine‑Tune Exchange‑Rate Policy to Accelerate Lira Depreciation
paras: 據知情人士透露，土耳其中央銀行總裁卡拉漢(Fatih Karahan)於曼谷出席國際貨幣基金(IMF)與世界銀行年會的閉門會議時向投資人透露，土耳其目前正允許里拉以更快的速度貶值，以防止未來長期出現更劇烈的匯率疲軟。
對於上述閉門會議的討論內容，土耳其央行拒絕發表評論。
據《彭博》報導，卡拉漢向投資人解釋，由於當前經濟活動有所放緩，匯率貶值對通膨的「傳遞效應」已有所減弱，這也是央行選擇在此時調整匯率貶值節奏的主因。
他強調維持可持續匯率架構的重要性，並指出其總裁任期將於 2028 年 2 月屆滿，希望能藉此建立穩定機制，防止繼任者未來感到有必要進行大幅度貶值，從而抹去迄今所取得的所有政策進展。
此外，卡拉漢補充說，微調貶值步調時必須確保國內儲戶與家庭能繼續認為持有里拉資產的報酬率具備吸引力。
土耳其央行長期以來將里拉的穩健放緩作為其「反通膨策略」的一環，採取實質貨幣升值的控管模式，即確保里拉每月的貶值幅度低於每月的通膨率。這種高度可預測的匯率走勢配合高利率政策，成功帶動了數十億美元的外資透過「利差交易」流入土耳其。
目前土耳其基準一周附買回利率(repo rate)高達 37%。隨著今年 9 月年通膨率近五年來首次降至 30% 以下，市場經濟學家預期，由卡拉漢主持的貨幣政策委員會(MPC)於下週開會時，可能將啟動降息措施。
paras_en: According to informed sources, Fatih Karahan, the governor of the Central Bank of the Republic of Turkey, told investors during a closed‑door meeting at the IMF‑World Bank Annual Meetings in Bangkok that Turkey is currently allowing the lira to depreciate at a faster pace to avert a much sharper long‑term weakening of the exchange rate.
The Central Bank of Turkey declined to comment on the content of the closed‑door meeting.

Bloomberg reported that Karahan explained to investors that, because economic activity has slowed, the “transmission effect” of exchange‑rate depreciation on inflation has already weakened, which is the main reason the bank chose to adjust the pace of depreciation now.

He stressed the importance of maintaining a sustainable exchange‑rate framework and noted that his term as governor ends in February 2028, hoping to establish a stable mechanism that prevents his successor from feeling compelled to enact a large‑scale depreciation that would erase all policy gains achieved so far.
Karahan also added that when fine‑tuning the depreciation pace, it must be ensured that domestic savers and households continue to view the return on lira‑denominated assets as attractive.

The Turkish central bank has long treated a gradual, stable slowdown of the lira as part of its “anti‑inflation strategy,” using a real‑appreciation control model that keeps the monthly lira depreciation rate below the monthly inflation rate. This highly predictable exchange‑rate path, combined with high‑interest‑rate policy, has successfully attracted billions of dollars of foreign capital through “carry‑trade” flows into Turkey.

Turkey’s benchmark one‑week repo rate is currently as high as 37%. With annual inflation falling below 30% for the first time in five years in September, market economists expect that the Monetary Policy Committee chaired by Karahan, which meets next week, may initiate a rate‑cutting move.

items.title_en: Far East Commercial Bank Focuses on US CPI Data, Dollar Generally Stable
paras: ◆USD/JPY

美國克利夫蘭聯邦儲備銀行總裁哈瑪克主張再升息，而且中東地區襲擊事件升級，激發避險需求，週二支撐美元指於十八個月高點，但預計美國不會在中期選舉前攻擊伊朗，避免中東局勢和烏克蘭衝突升級損害共和黨選情，油價料一周來首次下跌壓抑美元，並據日本央行(BOJ)公布日本9月企業物價指數(CGPI)較前月跌0.3%及較上年同期漲6.8%不及預期，但以日圓計價進口價格指數較去年同期增24.5%，突顯日圓貶值推高原料進口成本及通貨膨脹，保持BOJ近期再加息的臆測，同時BOJ季度調查顯示，9月日本家庭預期一年後物價上漲比例降至88.6%，但預期五年後物價上漲比例升至86.5%，而且國際貨幣基金組織(IMF)預計BOJ朝著中性水平逐步升息，激勵日圓上漲，美元兌日圓自158.66高點下跌。

據BOJ總裁植田和男稱，當前基礎通貨膨脹已非常接近2%目標，穩定在2%左右至關重要，而且亞洲股市大跌，引發日圓的避險需求，打壓美元兌日圓至157.81低點，但全美房地產經紀人協會(NAR)公布美國9月成屋銷售增1.5%至經季節調整年率達399萬戶，並據紐約聯邦儲備銀行總裁威廉姆斯認為明年無需再加息，但美國聯邦準備理事會(FED)理事沃勒稱，近期美國公債收益率上升反映經濟增長加快及通貨膨脹預期穩固，而且芝加哥聯邦儲備銀行總裁古爾斯比表示人工智能(AI)投資熱潮溢出效應引發通貨膨脹，推動美元反彈。今日聚焦美國通貨膨脹數據，預估美元兌日圓阻力於158.70-90，支撐於157.70-90。
◆EUR/USD
昨日據澳洲國民銀行(NAB)調查，澳洲9月企業現況指數維持負1，但企業信心指數跌至負13，遠低於伊朗衝突爆發前的2月水平，但9月澳洲央行(RBA)會議紀錄顯示，在國內需求過剩和全球能源成本上升背景下，通貨膨脹可能比此前預期更頑固，為必要時進行今年第五次升息留出空間，其鷹派基調支撐澳幣，扶助歐元兌美元穩守1.1152低點。
隨著德國9月消費者物價指數(CPI)及消費者物價調和指數(HICP)終值均較上年同期漲3.3%，與初值一致，而且IMF發布世界經濟展望表示，今年全球經濟下行風險增加，但AI投資強勁抵消中東戰爭衝擊，料增長率超過3.1%，而且油價回落壓抑美元，提振歐元兌美元至1.1204高點。預估今日歐元兌美元阻力於1.1210-30，支撐於1.1120-50。
◆GBP/USD

週二英國零售業聯盟(BRC)公布9月零售銷售較去年同期增長1.3%高於前值，但不及過去十二個月平均增幅，而且市場研究機構Worldpanel by Numerator表示截至10月4日四周內，英國食品雜貨價格通貨膨脹率加速升至2.5%，增添家庭帶來汽油和能源帳單上漲壓力，打擊英鎊兌美元至1.3201低點。隨著英國央行(BOE)貨幣政策委員會(MPC)委員格林表示IMF上調對英國今年經濟增長預測，更表明BOE利率水平不十分具限制性，推升英鎊兌美元至1.3259高點。預估今日英鎊兌美元阻力於1.3260-80，支撐於1.3160-80。

items.title_en: <New York Forex> Dollar Slides from 18-Month High as Oil Prices Fall, Inflation Data in Focus
paras: 美元周二(13日)自18個月高點滑落，隨著油價下跌，加上市場重新評估今年支撐美國資產需求、由人工智慧(AI)題材帶動的漲勢。投資人同時等待更多有關聯準會(Fed)利率政策走向的線索。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)下跌0.37%，報102.18。該指數週一曾升至102.61，創2025年4月以來最高。
Corpay首席市場策略師Karl Schamotta表示，「隨著市場對AI相關股票估值的合理性及漲勢能否持續產生更多疑慮，美元正走弱。這可能抑制流入美國金融市場的資金。」
紐約聯準銀行總裁威廉斯(John Williams)表示，他仍預期今年會再升息一次，但認為2027年沒有必要進一步升息。此番言論公布後，美元跌幅進一步擴大。
市場預期，美國總統川普將避免中東局勢進一步升級，因為更大規模的衝突可能損害他在下個月期中選舉前的政治支持度。
川普上週表示，美國不會在選舉前攻擊伊朗，他也在週日提及俄羅斯與烏克蘭之間的能源停火安排。
週二油價下跌0.75%，至每桶105.87 美元，交易人士正評估俄羅斯是否可能額外增加柴油供應。俄羅斯表示，其柴油出口量可恢復至高於川普在與莫斯科達成的協議中所提及水準。
分析師指出，除了能源因素之外，市場對AI帶動投資的前景日益存疑，也正在挑戰近期美元漲勢。
投資人正等待週三公布的美國9月消費者物價指數(CPI)，這項數據將進一步提供聯準會未來是否收緊貨幣政策的線索。
在兩名聯準會官員主張應蒐集更多證據，再決定是否有必要進一步緊縮政策後，投資人已放棄對本月稍晚升息的押注。
芝商所(CME Group)FedWatch工具顯示，交易員預期聯準會在10月27至28日會議上維持利率不變的機率約為80%，高於一個月前的51%。另一方面，市場目前預期截至2027年底，聯準會累計緊縮幅度約為75個基點。
渣打銀行全球G10外匯研究主管暨北美宏觀策略主管Steven Englander表示，「我們認為通膨數據可能會略低於預期。油價仍帶來一些數據公布前的風險，但推升核心通膨的部分因素正在消退。關稅已經是去年的話題了。」
近期油價上漲曾支撐美元，並使歐元、日元等貨幣承壓，因歐元區與日本的經濟對進口石油的依賴程度遠高於美國。
歐元反彈 儘管天然氣價格升高
儘管天然氣價格再度大漲，而天然氣是推升歐元區通膨的重要因素之一，加上法國財政前景仍令人擔憂，歐元仍從約17個月低點反彈。
歐元兌美元上漲0.40%，至1歐元兌1.1198 美元。週一歐元曾跌至1.11525美元，為2025年5月以來最低。
Englander表示，「歐洲各國公債殖利率利差略有收斂。就市場對法國財政脆弱性的看法而言，我們還沒有到達最高警戒狀態，相關擔憂已經有所緩和。」
歐洲天然氣價格升至2022年12月以來最高水準，最新報價為每百萬瓦時86.74歐元。
日本銀行(BoJ)公布數據顯示，日本9月批發物價年增率為6.8%，低於市場預估中位數的7.6%。儘管如此，數據仍足以支撐市場對日本利率可能進一步上升的擔憂。日元兌美元升值0.18%，至158.33日元兌1美元。
投資人仍認為，日銀進一步收緊貨幣政策的可能性，以及官方可能出手干預過度的匯率波動，將為日元提供支撐。
澳幣兌美元報0.69830美元。此前，澳洲央行(RBA)公布9月會議紀錄，顯示委員會一致同意今年第四度升息。

paras_en: The dollar slipped from its 18‑month peak on Tuesday (the 13th) as oil prices fell and the market reassessed this year’s demand for U.S. assets, which had been buoyed by AI‑related themes. Investors are also waiting for more clues on the Federal Reserve’s rate‑policy direction.

In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, fell 0.37% to 102.18. The index had risen to 102.61 on Monday, its highest level since April 2025.

Corpay chief market strategist Karl Schamotta said, “As the market grows more skeptical about the valuation and sustainability of AI‑related stocks, the dollar is weakening. This could curb capital flows into U.S. financial markets.”

New York Fed Bank President John Williams said he still expects one more rate hike this year but sees no need for further tightening in 2027. The dollar’s decline widened after his comments were released.
The market expects President Trump to avoid a further escalation in the Middle East, as a larger conflict could damage his political support ahead of next month’s mid‑term elections.
Trump said last week that the United States would not attack Iran before the election, and on Sunday he also referenced the energy cease‑fire arrangement between Russia and Ukraine.

Oil prices fell 0.75% on Tuesday to $105.87 a barrel as traders evaluated whether Russia might increase diesel supplies. Russia said its diesel exports could rise above the levels mentioned in Trump’s agreement with Moscow.
Analysts note that beyond energy factors, doubts are growing about the investment outlook driven by AI, which is also challenging the recent dollar rally.
Investors are awaiting the U.S. September Consumer Price Index (CPI) release on Wednesday, which will provide further clues on whether the Fed will tighten monetary policy further.
After two Fed officials argued that more evidence should be gathered before deciding on additional tightening, investors have abandoned bets on a rate hike later this month.

CME Group’s FedWatch tool shows traders now assign about an 80% probability that the Fed will keep rates unchanged at its Oct. 27‑28 meeting, up from 51% a month ago. The market also expects the Fed’s cumulative tightening by the end of 2027 to be about 75 basis points.

Standard Chartered’s global G10 FX research head and North America macro‑strategy lead Steven Englander said, “We think inflation data may come in slightly below expectations. Oil prices still pose some pre‑data‑release risk, but the factors pushing core inflation are receding. Tariffs were already a topic of last year.”
Recent oil price gains had supported the dollar and put pressure on the euro, yen and other currencies, as the euro‑zone and Japan rely far more on imported oil than the United States does.
Euro rebounds despite higher gas prices

Even though natural‑gas prices have surged again—and gas is a key driver of euro‑zone inflation—combined with lingering concerns over France’s fiscal outlook, the euro has bounced from a roughly 17‑month low.
The euro rose 0.40% against the dollar to $1.1198. On Monday it had slipped to $1.11525, the lowest since May 2025.

Englander added, “Euro‑area sovereign‑yield spreads have narrowed slightly. Regarding market views on France’s fiscal fragility, we haven’t hit the highest alert level yet, and related worries have eased.”
European natural‑gas prices climbed to their highest level since December 2022, now at €86.74 per megawatt‑hour.

Bank of Japan data showed Japan’s September wholesale‑price year‑over‑year growth at 6.8%, below the median market forecast of 7.6%. Nonetheless, the figure is enough to sustain concerns that Japanese rates could rise further. The yen appreciated 0.18% to ¥158.33 per dollar.
Investors still believe that the possibility of further BOJ tightening and potential official intervention to curb excessive exchange‑rate moves will support the yen.
The Australian dollar was at $0.69830. Earlier, the Reserve Bank of Australia released September meeting minutes showing the committee unanimously agreed to a fourth rate hike this year.
